description:
**About ElevenLabs**
--------------------


ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.


We launched in January 2023 with the first human\-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses \- from fast\-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B \- multiples of 11, always.  

  

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

* ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
* ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70\+ languages.
* ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.


Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team \- builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex\-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

**How we work**
---------------

* **High\-velocity:** Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* **Impact not job titles:** We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
* **AI first:** We use AI to move faster with higher\-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
* **Excellence everywhere:** Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
* **Global team:** We prioritize your talent, not your location.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Innovative culture:** You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
* **Growth paths:** Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact \- beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
* **Learning \& development**: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
* **Social travel**: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
* **Annual company offsite:** Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location \- past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
* **Co\-working**: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co\-working stipend.

**About the role**
------------------


ElevenReader is our fast\-growing consumer audio app, and creative is one of our biggest growth levers. We’re looking for a Creative Producer to deliver creative marketing campaigns, experiments, and to build the creative engine that powers performance marketing across every major acquisition channel.


This role sits at the intersection of creative design, AI, and performance marketing. You’ll be our lead creative strategist, producing high\-quality creative concepts, building scalable creative workflows using AI tools, developing a testing roadmap, launching experiments across Meta, Google, YouTube, Reddit, and emerging platforms with our Performance Marketing team. You’ll partner closely with Marketing, Design, Growth Analytics, and partner agencies to continuously discover which creative drives acquisition at scale, and feeding these insights back into future creative roadmaps.


This is one part strategist and one part creative producer for someone who loves combining exceptional creative taste with rigorous experimentation and marketing results.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Designing creative systems, concepts and templates, mood boards, briefs, and AI workflows that power high\-velocity ad production
* Create visually\-stunning, brand aligned, static ad campaigns end\-to\-end in Figma and ElevenLabs
* Directing agency partners with clear and compelling creative briefs, UGC scripts, storyboards, scripts, and feedback on creative concepts, ensuring the timely and aligned delivery of assets
* Creating and launching creative testing programs across Meta, Google, YouTube, Reddit, and emerging acquisition channels with Performance Marketing and agencies
* Developing a structured creative roadmap with recurring testing sprints and clear learning agendas
* Designing analytical frameworks to identify winning creative patterns using performance data and creative analysis
* Researching and mapping creative trends across competitors, consumer categories, and best\-in\-class mobile apps to generate new hypotheses for testing
* Partnering closely with Performance Marketing and agencies to rapidly iterate and scale winning campaigns
* Continuously improving our creative production pipeline through AI automation, reusable templates, and scalable workflows
* Analyzing which creative is resonating most with our audience through ad platforms and tools like Motion
* Raising the creative quality bar while ensuring every asset is designed to maximize measurable business outcomes

**Requirements**
----------------

* 5\+ years of experience in performance creative, art direction, growth marketing, creative strategy, or design at a high\-growth consumer product or technology company
* Deep expertise with generative AI for image and video creation, with a strong understanding of how to build repeatable creative workflows with tools like ElevenCreative
* Experience creating high\-performing ads across Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, or other major paid acquisition platforms
* Experience with creative performance analytics tools like Motion
* Strong understanding of creative experimentation, performance marketing, A/B testing, and data\-driven optimization
* Expert proficiency in Figma, CapCut, Adobe Suite and modern AI creative tools and generative media platforms
* Exceptional visual taste with the ability to balance speed, quality, and brand consistency
* Deep understanding of user psychology and what drives successful consumer marketing
* Highly analytical and structured thinker who enjoys building experimentation frameworks and extracting insights from data
* Self\-directed builder who thrives in fast\-moving environments and can independently take ideas from concept to launch

**Bonus**
---------

* Power user of ElevenCreative, including Flows and Templates
* Background in building AI\-powered creative production systems or internal creative tooling
* Passion for consumer products, AI, storytelling, and building globally loved brands.

**Location**
------------


This role is remote with a preference for timezones in US \- East and Europe

title: Senior UA Creative Strategist - Mobile Games
description:
The Role
We are looking for a sharp, highly curious **UA Creative Strategist** to help us decide what advertising creatives we should make and why.


This is not primarily a video editing or art production role. Your job is to stay ahead of the mobile games advertising market, spot emerging creative opportunities, understand what is working and what is becoming stale, and turn those insights into strong concepts and clear production briefs.


You will sit at the intersection of **creative, user acquisition, games and data**.


We want someone who watches the market closely, studies competitors, understands internet culture and short\-form video, experiments aggressively, and is constantly asking:

**“What should we test next?”**


You will work with our UA team and with internal and external creators, editors, artists, AI tools and production partners to turn those ideas into ads.  

What You’ll Do


Own Our UA Creative Direction* Develop a continuous pipeline of new video ad concepts, hooks, formats and creative hypotheses.
* Decide which ideas are worth producing and testing based on market trends, player psychology, competitor activity and our own performance data.
* Build a weekly creative roadmap rather than waiting for production requests.
* Push beyond obvious variations of existing ads and actively search for new creative angles.


Hunt for Trends and Creative Opportunities* Constantly research mobile game advertising across TikTok, Meta, YouTube, AppLovin, Google, Unity, Mintegral and emerging channels.
* Study successful ads from both direct competitors and completely different genres and industries.
* Deconstruct winning creatives by looking at the hook, pacing, storytelling structure, gameplay, visual treatment, sound, creator style, emotional trigger and CTA.
* Track broader TikTok, Reels, Shorts, creator and internet culture trends and identify which ones can be translated into performance advertising.
* Maintain a living library of interesting ads, formats, hooks and creative patterns.


Turn Insights Into Things We Can Actually Make* Write clear, production\-ready creative briefs, scripts, storyboards and references.
* Explain not just **what** to make, but the hypothesis behind the idea and what we are trying to learn.
* Give strong creative direction and feedback to video editors, motion designers, game capture teams, UGC creators, AI creators and external agencies.
* Help producers and artists understand the intent of a concept without prescribing every frame.
* Review work in progress and push execution until the original creative idea comes through clearly.


Build a Modern Creative Testing Machine* Work closely with UA managers to understand CTR, IPM, CVR, CPI, ROAS, retention and other creative performance signals.
* Identify why a creative worked rather than simply declaring it a winner.
* Turn winning ads into structured families of new hypotheses rather than endless minor variations.
* Kill weak directions quickly and double down aggressively when a concept shows promise.
* Watch for creative fatigue and ensure the pipeline always has genuinely fresh ideas entering testing.


Use AI Aggressively, but Intelligently* Stay current with AI image, video, voice, scripting and editing tools.
* Use AI to prototype ideas, explore concepts and generate variations rapidly.
* Understand where AI production is good enough, where human production is better, and when the two should be combined.
* Experiment with AI\-native formats and workflows rather than treating AI only as a cheaper production tool.
* Help us continuously evaluate new creative tools, platforms and production partners.


Direct External Production* Identify and brief specialist agencies, UGC creators, freelance editors, AI studios and playable ad providers when appropriate.
* Evaluate external creative partners based on performance, speed and creative thinking, not simply production polish.
* Give vendors decisive feedback and keep projects moving.
* Help us build a flexible production network capable of executing very different kinds of ideas quickly.


Creative Formats You Should Be Comfortable With
You do not need to personally produce all of these, but you should understand how and when to use them:

* Gameplay\-led video
* TikTok, Reels and Shorts\-native ads
* UGC and creator\-style ads
* Gameplay reviews and reaction formats
* Narrative and story\-driven ads
* Failure, challenge and transformation formats
* Humor, memes and culturally relevant concepts
* AI\-generated and AI\-assisted video
* 2D and 3D animation
* Live action
* Playable and interactive ads
* Static and lightweight motion concepts
* We care much more about **choosing the right format for the idea** than having a preferred production style


What This Role Is Not
This is **not** a traditional brand Creative Director role.


It is **not** primarily a video editor position.


It is also **not** a UA media buying position.


We are hiring the person who sits between those disciplines. This person is responsible for understanding the market, generating the hypotheses, choosing the creative directions, briefing the people who make them, and learning from the results.


What Success Looks Like
You have created a repeatable rhythm where we always know:

**What are we testing? Why are we testing it? What did we learn? What should we make next?**


Over time, we should see a larger and more diverse pipeline of strong creative ideas, faster learning cycles, more creative winners, less dependence on a small number of exhausted concepts, and better UA performance as a result.


Above all, we want someone who develops a reputation inside the company for constantly bringing us ideas we would not have thought of ourselves.

 **Requirements**  

  

What We’re Looking For* Around **3 to 5 years of relevant experience** in mobile games, mobile apps, performance creative, creative strategy, advertising or a closely related field.
* Strong understanding of mobile game UA creative and performance advertising.
* Exceptional instinct for short\-form video, including hooks, pacing, storytelling, visual communication and attention.
* Strong analytical thinking and comfort interpreting creative performance data.
* Ability to look at an advertisement and explain *why* it works.
* Ability to turn insights into clear creative hypotheses and actionable briefs.
* Deep curiosity about games, advertising, internet culture, creators and emerging formats.
* Strong familiarity with current generative AI creative tools and workflows.
* Excellent communication and creative feedback skills.
* High initiative. You should naturally research, experiment and bring us ideas without waiting to be asked.
* Comfortable challenging existing assumptions when you believe there is a better direction.


Nice to Have* Previous mobile game Creative Strategist or Creative Producer experience.
* Experience with casual or hybrid\-casual games.
* Experience working directly with Meta, TikTok, Google or major mobile ad networks.
* Familiarity with creative intelligence tools such as Sensor Tower, AppMagic, Apptica, Meta Ads Library or TikTok’s creative tools.
* Experience briefing and managing UGC creators or external creative agencies.
* Knowledge of playable ads.
* Basic hands\-on ability with CapCut, Premiere, After Effects or similar tools.
* Ability to quickly make a rough edit, AI prototype or visual mockup to communicate an idea.
* Game capture, Unity or other game development familiarity.

  

**Benefits**  

* Market competitive, tax\-free USD salaries
* Paid Time Off
* Performance Bonus
* Annual Performance Reviews

In this role, you will help define the creative vision, develop distinctive and engaging formats, and ensure that each show aligns with the overall channel strategy, brand positioning, and audience ambition.


You will work closely with an external production agency responsible for execution, providing creative guidance throughout the process, challenging and refining ideas, reviewing key creative decisions, and ensuring the final output stays true to the agreed vision and strategy.

* Deep understanding of YouTube formats, audience behavior, storytelling, and creator culture.

* Experience developing content for international or multi\-market audiences is highly desirable.
* Experience within beauty, fashion, lifestyle, or adjacent consumer categories is a plus, but not essential.

  

**Benefits**  

* **Flexible Engagement Structure:** This opportunity is offered under an independent service\-provider agreement, giving you the freedom to shape how you deliver your expertise. You define your own working methods, organise your schedule independently, and contribute your skills to clearly scoped projects. Compensation is agreed individually and reflects your experience, capabilities, and the value you bring to each engagement.
* **Location Freedom:** You can deliver services from any suitable location that supports high\-quality outcomes, whether that’s your home office, a co\-working space, or wherever you feel most productive and inspired. What matters most is the impact you create and the reliability of your delivery.
* **Global Network and Inspiring Projects:** You’ll collaborate with a diverse international network of professionals across 85\+ countries, contributing to projects that reach vast audiences and help shape the future of digital content. This is an opportunity to work alongside talented specialists, exchange ideas, and be part of meaningful initiatives with real global reach.
* **Smooth Collaboration and Project Support:** To enable efficient service delivery, we provide modern collaboration platforms, clear project coordination, and streamlined processes. This helps you focus your energy where it matters most, producing high\-impact work and bringing creative solutions to life.
* **Make a Global Impact:** Your expertise will contribute to initiatives that influence audiences worldwide. Join projects that push creative boundaries and help build the next generation of digital experiences.

description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

Are you a strategist who makes, or a maker who thinks strategically? Can you turn an ambiguous enterprise challenge into a shared point of view, a testable experience, and evidence for the next decision? If you believe the best AI\-enabled services are designed with clients and their users \- not simply delivered to them \- you will feel at home in the **AI Innovation Lab** with **Kyndryl Vital** .


**Kyndryl Vital** is a global network of designers, engineers, researchers, writers, and strategists helping organizations make sense of complexity and create experiences that are useful, responsible, and buildable. We combine behavioral insight, business understanding, and deep technology expertise so ideas can move beyond aspiration into delivery, adoption, and measurable value.


Based in Madrid and serving clients across Europe, the **AI Innovation Lab** is part studio, part workshop, and part proving ground. Client sponsors, frontline users, Kyndryl designers, and technologists work together in short, focused cycles: framing a challenge, making possibilities tangible, testing prototypes, and deciding what to stop, iterate, pilot, or scale. We favor demos over decks and evidence over opinion.


**The opportunity**

We are hiring two to three Creative Technologists who can bridge human\-centered design, business strategy, and emerging technology. This is a shared role family, not a search for identical candidates. Everyone should be comfortable moving from ambiguity to a testable artifact, but each person will bring greater depth in one of two complementary profiles.


* **Strategic / Conceptual profile:** stronger in problem framing, systems thinking, co\-design, service and conversational experience, synthesis, and helping senior stakeholders make decisions through tangible artifacts.
* **Practical / Technical profile:** stronger in rapid functional prototyping, low\-code and AI platforms, APIs, data integration, agentic patterns, and turning workshop outputs into working demonstrations.

We do not expect every candidate to be equally deep in both profiles. We do expect curiosity across the full cycle, generosity in multidisciplinary teams, and the ability to make their thinking visible. Together, the Lab team should be able to frame, facilitate, build, test, and hand off.


**What you will do**

* **Shape the right challenge.** Work with sponsors and users to locate the real decision inside a broad brief, understand the current system, and define the behavior, outcome, or learning the engagement should create.
* **Design and facilitate co\-creation.** Create participatory sessions for executives, subject\-matter experts, frontline users, designers, and engineers. Enable people with different levels of confidence and authority to contribute meaningfully.
* **Make ideas tangible early.** Use sketches, scenarios, conversation flows, simulations, low\-code tools, or working software to give participants something concrete to react to and improve.
* **Prototype with people.** Build during and between sessions, incorporating feedback while the problem and trade\-offs are still visible. Choose fidelity deliberately: each artifact should answer a question or unlock a decision.
* **Design human\-agent collaboration.** Create clear patterns for autonomy, approvals, escalation, uncertainty, exceptions, rollback, and human override so users remain informed and in control.
* **Test value and feasibility together.** Explore desirability, business value, data readiness, integration, security, operational impact, cost, and maintainability before recommending a pilot.
* **Turn learning into direction.** Synthesize observations and prototype evidence into opportunity areas, principles, requirements, success measures, and a credible stop / iterate / pilot / scale recommendation.
* **Create a clean path to delivery.** Partner with FDEs, architects, security, data, Consult Partners and delivery leads so validated concepts have an owner, documented assumptions, and an appropriate route forward.
* **Help build the Lab as a capability.** Contribute reusable methods, starter environments, component libraries, evaluation sets, showcases, and decision rituals so every engagement starts faster and leaves knowledge behind.

  

**Who You Are**

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise. What you bring.**

* **Human\-centered and systemic thinking.** You apply human\-centered design and design thinking techniques at a strategic level, connecting user behavior and lived experience with business goals, operating models, incentives, technology constraints, and wider organizational consequences.
* **Strategy through making.** You use artifacts and experiments to reduce ambiguity, surface assumptions, and improve decisions rather than treating prototyping as a final presentation step.
* **Participatory facilitation.** You can prepare and lead executive workshops and hands\-on making sessions, read the room, rebalance participation, and adapt the plan without losing the intended outcome.
* **Cross\-disciplinary fluency.** You collaborate credibly with Consult, design, business, FDEs, data, architecture, security, and client teams without pretending to be the deepest expert in every discipline.
* **AI experience literacy.** You understand how generative and agentic systems behave, where they fail, and how to design for uncertainty, trust, feedback, and appropriate human control.
* **Responsible experimentation.** You make data use, model limitations, permissions, safety, auditability, and ethical trade\-offs explicit, proportionate to the risk and maturity of the prototype.
* **Evidence\-led storytelling.** You communicate a compelling possibility while distinguishing what has been observed, assumed, simulated, validated, and still needs to be learned.
* **Enterprise pragmatism.** You move quickly while respecting governance, security, accessibility, and the realities of complex organizations.
* **Service Design.**

**Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise** . **Depth in at least one profile:**

**1\) Creative Technologist – AI Strategy**

Advanced problem framing, systems thinking, design research, or experience strategy.


Design of co\-creation formats that move groups from divergent perspectives to shared choices.


Synthesis of qualitative evidence into insights, hypotheses, principles, opportunity areas, and roadmaps.


Conversational and agentic experience design, including roles, boundaries, handoffs, and exception journeys.


Executive communication and the ability to challenge solution\-first thinking constructively.


Enough prototyping fluency to make ideas testable using tools such as Figma, Miro, or low\-code platforms.


**2\) Creative Technologist – AI Experience Prototype**

Rapid creation of functional prototypes using low\-code platforms, AI\-assisted development, or code.


Hands\-on experience with generative AI, prompt and context design, tool use, structured outputs, and agentic workflows.


Working knowledge of RAG, APIs, data integration, identity, permissions, and enterprise cloud patterns.


Ability to create credible web or conversational interfaces and represent loading, uncertainty, error, and edge cases.


Practical evaluation of response quality, groundedness, safety, latency, reliability, and cost.


Clear documentation of what is functional, simulated, reusable, and required for a production implementation.


**Tools and technologies**

You do not need experience with every product below. We are interested in transferable capability and evidence of learning quickly. The Lab's working environment is expected to include:


* **Co\-creation and experience design:** Figma, FigJam, Miro, or equivalent tools.
* **Low\-code and automation:** Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Apps, Power Automate, or equivalent platforms.
* **AI prototyping:** Microsoft Foundry / Azure AI, model playgrounds, prompt and agent tooling, and evaluation services.
* **Knowledge and integration:** SharePoint, Dataverse, Azure AI Search or other RAG components, APIs, and connectors.
* **Development:** VS Code, GitHub, API clients, and enough front\-end or scripting capability to produce a credible prototype when low\-code is not sufficient.
* **Quality and operations:** test sets, observability, content safety, accessibility checks, and basic cost monitoring.

**What success looks like**

Lab engagements end with a clearer decision, not just more ideas.


A first testable artifact is produced in days or weeks, with fidelity matched to the question.


Clients and users can see how their input changed the concept and understand the trade\-offs.


Evidence, assumptions, risks, data needs, and unresolved questions are documented honestly.


Validated concepts transition with a sponsor, success measures, and a realistic technical and operational path.


Methods, components, and learning are reused across engagements rather than being lost after the demo.


**Experience and education**

A strong portfolio showing how you moved from ambiguity to a tangible outcome and what was learned. We are particularly interested in your decisions, contribution, trade\-offs, and evidence \- not only polished screens.


Relevant professional experience in creative technology, service or product design, innovation, engineering, or consulting. At this level, this is typically five or more years, but demonstrated scope and impact matter more than tenure alone.


Experience working with enterprise clients or similarly complex stakeholder, governance, and delivery environments.


Professional fluency in English \& Spanish. Another European language is an advantage.


Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience and demonstrable portfolio. Advanced study or continued education in design, HCI, technology, business, or AI is welcome but not required.


**Location and working model:** Madrid, Spain \- hybrid, with regular in\-person work in the AI Innovation Lab and at client locations.


**Country/Region:** Spain / European Principal Markets.  



  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

description:
Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico \& Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House \& Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Location:
   

  

 London, GB
   

  

 Condé Nast is a global media company, home to iconic brands including Vogue, GQ, Glamour, CN Traveller, Vanity Fair, Wired, The World of Interiors, House \& Garden and Tatler, among many others.
   

  

 We are headquartered in New York and London and operate in 32 markets worldwide, with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers across print, digital, video and social platforms.
   

  

 Condé Nast thrives on collaboration, and our teams come together in the office four days a week (Monday \- Thursday).
   

  

 We value diversity of background, views and cultures. We celebrate people for their personal qualities, skills and contributions, recognising the power our brands have to influence and shape culture.
   

  

 Condé Nast is a global media company producing the highest quality content with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers in 32 territories through print, digital, video and social platforms. The company’s portfolio includes many of the world’s most respected and influential media properties including Vogue, Vanity Fair, Glamour, Self, GQ, The New Yorker, Condé Nast Traveler/Traveller, Allure, AD, Bon Appétit and Wired, among others.
   

  

 Based in our London office, this role helps to set the creative vision and leads the overarching delivery of global and UK branded content, advertiser partnerships, and brand marketing across Condé Nast’s editorial portfolio. As a culturally attuned, conceptual leader, you will drive 360° creative strategy that connects brands to culture at scale. You bring a track record of editorially inspired work, natural mentorship, and the capability to deputise for the Executive Creative Director—aiding in guiding the department vision, setting creative standards, and inspiring the wider team.
   

  

 Reporting to the Executive Creative Director, you will partner with senior marketing, strategy, and sales leaders to shape major commercial opportunities, pitch transformative partnership ideas, and oversee cross\-departmental execution with editorial teams. Success requires visionary storytelling, deep commercial strategy, and a sharp cultural perspective. The Creative Director oversees overall portfolio output, establishing the creative direction and directing senior talent on high\-stakes, multi\-platform briefs—from global luxury video campaigns to multi\-market event sponsorships.
   

  

 You excel at guiding cross\-functional teams through complex, fast\-paced workflows, bringing executive\-level problem\-solving and strategic clarity to every meeting. The ideal candidate ensures creative excellence while safeguarding Condé Nast’s brand authority, creative standards, and journalistic integrity across all commercial initiatives.
   

  

 Individual \& Team Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop bold multi\-channel creative work that reflects the voice and ethos of all Condé Nast titles for advertisers across categories.
* Assign, collaborate with and direct the work of multi\-disciplinary creatives suitable for each project (art directors, designers, etc).
* Apply strategic insights in order to craft inventive content, experiential solutions, and partnership ideas that align with audience data, brand ethos, and client objectives.
* Direct video and photo shoots with a focus on performance and editorial quality.
* Serve as the primary creative client liaison on campaigns—presenting work, managing feedback, and guiding creative integrity across production.
* Drive brainstorms and work hands\-on when crafting proposals and presentations.
* Propose creative solutions that fit within the provided budgets.
* Ensure all commercial ideas authentically balance the voices and perspectives of our editorial brands with those of our advertising partners.
* Help build a thriving creative department; nurture talent, establish workflow efficiencies, and champion inclusive, forward\-thinking creative culture.
* Deputise for the Executive Creative Director across key business forums, internal leadership meetings, and executive client pitches.


**Essential Skills \& Requirements**
* 10\+ years of experience as a creative lead in premium media or agency environments.
* A demonstrated appreciation for the subject matter and creativity of the brands you’ll represent at Condé Nast.
* Confidence working with and directing artists, experts, celebrities and creators as talent on commercial projects.
* Strong portfolio showcasing work across print, digital, video and events.
* Passion for brand marketing, with a sharp cultural perspective that informs consumer\-facing campaigns.
* Skilled storyteller with excellent written, visual, and verbal presentation abilities.
* Extensive on\-set experience and deep knowledge of video and photography production, from pre\- to post\-production (for digital and print).
* Demonstrated success managing creative teams and working within established systems to improve output and efficiency.
* A creative aesthetic emphasizing current standards in entertainment, fashion, luxury and design.
* Highly organized, adaptable and adept at prioritizing workloads in fast\-paced environments.
* Ability to work fluently with collaborators in production \- writers, DPs, photographers, editors, animators, and designers.
* Proficiency in Google Slides and treatment deck creation. Bonus: familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite and editing software.


**Desired Qualities**
* Culturally informed \- Current on music and entertainment, luxury and fashion, as well as knowledgeable about Condé Nast brands and culture. Additionally, have awareness of relevant artists, and creative vendors.
* Highly imaginative \- You’re a conceptual creative with innovative ideas that challenge outdated approaches to content and the definition of “experiential.”
* Detail\-oriented \- Equally obsessed with creating memorable work and impactful campaigns that solve our client’s challenges.
* Agile and adaptable \- Open to taking input from others and willing to take on essential tasks needed to get the job done.
* Think critically \- You strive to come up with ideas that solve brand challenges, can manage multiple projects at once, and know when to pivot if something isn’t working.
* Have an ego\-less attitude \- You give credit where credit is due, bring a positive attitude to work and support your teammates in gaining visibility and opportunities.
* A natural mentor \- You prioritize diversity, inclusivity, and representation in every stage of the creative process and empathy in team collaboration.


 What benefits do we offer?
   

  

* 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays) and extra days of annual leave if you move house or want to volunteer.
* You’ll have access to a competitive pension scheme, Bupa Private Healthcare, Season ticket loans and eye tests.
* We offer a range of tools to support your wellbeing, including core hours, 10 remote days (from home or a country with a Condé Nast office location), access to our Employee Assistance Programme, corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.
* We’re a dog\-friendly office, plus you’ll enjoy discounts and magazine subscriptions, keeping you up to date with all things Condé Nast.
* We encourage personal and professional growth through the Condé Nast Learning Hub, where you’ll find an extensive portfolio of learning courses and training available in local languages.
* Our Employee Resource Groups provide a platform for employees to identify shared objectives, exchange ideas, and work on community priorities for our global workforce.

 If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply below, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile.
   

  

***Condé Nast is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, familial status and other legally protected characteristics.***

title: Executive Creative Director
description:
**About Uncovered:**
 Uncovered is an award\-winning, London\-based social\-first creative agency founded in 2017\.
   

  

 Social sits at the heart of everything we do.
   

  

 From strategy to production, our team is fluent in the language of social, with a deep understanding of culture, platforms and the audiences that shape them. Working with a diverse portfolio of brands, we uncover what makes each one distinctive and create ideas built for where attention lives today. Our approach is rooted in social\-first fundamentals: real people, real stories and video\-first creativity.
   

  

 We create at the speed of social; strategising, ideating, designing and producing through our team of in\-house strategists, creatives, art directors, copywriters, producers, editors and videographers. We test, learn and iterate in real time, delivering end\-to\-end solutions from creative strategy through to production, reporting and analytics.
   

  

 Named Campaign's Social Media Agency of the Year in 2026, Uncovered has become one of the UK's fastest\-growing creative agencies, driven by a simple ambition: to build the best social\-first creative agency in the world. Today, as part of LBG Media, we combine independent creative thinking with unrivalled social insight and cultural influence to help brands create work that earns attention and drives meaningful impact.
   

  

 Our culture is as important as our creative. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, collaborative thinking and an environment where people can do the best work of their careers. With women representing around 60% of our leadership team, we're committed to building an inclusive, ambitious culture where talent is nurtured, creativity thrives and everyone has the opportunity to make a difference.
   

  

**The Role:**
 The Executive Creative Director is responsible for defining and leading Uncovered's creative vision, ensuring every piece of work reflects the agency's ambition to create culture\-driving, social\-first campaigns that deliver commercial impact.
   

  

 As the creative leader of the agency, the Executive Creative Director sets the creative standard across all clients, pitches and outputs, inspiring teams to produce work that is platform\-native, culturally influential and impossible to ignore.
   

  

 This role combines creative leadership, strategic thinking and commercial awareness to shape the agency's creative direction, develop world\-class talent and strengthen Uncovered's reputation as one of the industry's leading social\-first agencies.
   

  

 Working closely with the Head of Client Services, Partnerships Director, Production teams and the Leadership Team, the Executive Creative Director ensures creative excellence is embedded throughout the agency while continually evolving Uncovered's creative offering in line with culture, technology and changing platform behaviours.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
**Creative Vision \& Leadership**
* Define and champion Uncovered's creative vision, standards and point of view across the agency.
* Own the overall quality of creative output across all clients, campaigns and new business.
* Set the benchmark for social\-first creativity, ensuring ideas are culturally relevant, platform\-native and commercially effective.
* Act as the agency's final creative authority, providing leadership and creative sign\-off where required.
* Build an environment where ambitious thinking, experimentation and creative excellence thrive.


**Agency Growth \& Creative Reputation**
* Lead the agency's creative contribution to new business, pitches and strategic opportunities.
* Shape Uncovered's creative positioning within the industry and strengthen its reputation through award\-winning work, thought leadership and innovation.
* Identify emerging opportunities across platforms, creator ecosystems, AI and new technologies that enhance the agency's creative offering.
* Represent the agency externally with clients, partners, industry events and media.


**Creative Strategy \& Campaign Development**
* Oversee the development of breakthrough creative ideas from insight through to execution.
* Partner with Strategy to translate audience, cultural and behavioural insights into distinctive creative platforms.
* Ensure campaigns balance entertainment, storytelling, effectiveness and measurable business outcomes.
* Champion creator\-led thinking, social storytelling and platform\-first creative across every brief.


**Creative Excellence \& Innovation**
* Maintain exceptional standards of craft, originality and effectiveness across every project.
* Encourage experimentation with new creative formats, production techniques, technologies and storytelling approaches.
* Drive innovation across AI, creator collaboration, production workflows and emerging social platforms.
* Ensure work reflects the speed, authenticity and behaviours of modern social media.


**Team Leadership \& Creative Culture**
* Build, mentor and inspire a high\-performing creative department.
* Coach Creative Directors and senior creatives, developing the next generation of creative leaders.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive and high\-performance culture where creativity can flourish.
* Provide clear, constructive feedback that elevates both ideas and individuals.
* Promote curiosity, cultural awareness and continuous learning across the department.


**Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Partner closely with Strategy, Client Services, Production and Operations to ensure creative ambition is delivered efficiently.
* Balance creative excellence with commercial objectives, operational realities and client needs.
* Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, confidently presenting and defending creative work.
* Support agency leadership in shaping business strategy, capability growth and long\-term creative evolution.


**Experience \& Qualifications:**
* 18\+ years' experience in creative agencies with significant experience leading integrated and social\-first creative teams.
* Proof of awarding work from industry industry bodies \- Cannes Lions, Effies, IPAs etc.
* Proven experience as an Executive Creative Director, Creative Director or equivalent senior creative leadership role.
* Outstanding portfolio demonstrating culturally relevant, social\-first campaigns with measurable commercial impact.
* Experience leading large multidisciplinary creative teams across strategy, design, copy, creators and production.
* Proven success leading major pitches, client relationships and agency growth initiatives.
* Experience building award\-winning creative work and developing agency reputation.
* Deep understanding of creator culture, digital communities, platform behaviours and evolving consumer trends.

**Skills:**
* Visionary creative leadership.
* Exceptional conceptual and strategic thinking.
* Deep understanding of culture, creators and social platforms.
* Ability to inspire, mentor and build high\-performing creative teams.

* High creative standards with outstanding attention to craft.
* Confident decision\-maker with the ability to provide clear creative direction.
* Curious, innovative and always looking to evolve the agency's creative offering.

**Benefits:**

title: Art Director - RuneScape
description:
**Location: Cambridge, UK** 
 \- This position offers flexible working options, including predominantly remote work. Applicants are preferably based (or willing to relocate) within a comfortable commuting distance of our office to attend onsite as required.
   

  

**Can you give one of gaming's longest\-running worlds a clear visual voice—and lead the team shaping its next era?**
 RuneScape has welcomed more than 300 million player accounts across 25 years. As the game progresses along its
 **Road to Restoration** 
 , we're looking for an Art Director to define and champion the visual direction behind its next chapter.
   

  

 You'll take ownership of RuneScape's artistic vision across environments, characters, creatures, UI, VFX, lighting and cinematics, bringing greater quality, consistency and clarity to the experience across PC and mobile. You'll lead a large multidisciplinary art team, setting a clear creative direction while staying close to the day\-to\-day realities of live game development.
   

  

 You'll have genuine autonomy to assess how the team operates, evolve its structure and raise the quality bar across the game. Your work will directly influence player experience, the desirability of cosmetic content and the long\-term visual strategy of one of the world's most established MMORPGs.
   

  

**What you'll be doing:**
* Own and evolve RuneScape's visual direction, creating a cohesive artistic vision across environments, characters, creatures, UI, VFX, lighting and cinematics while respecting the game's established identity.
* Lead and develop a large multidisciplinary art team, assessing its structure, capabilities and craft standards to ensure it is set up to deliver at the required quality and pace.
* Establish and maintain a clear quality bar, reviewing work throughout development and providing actionable direction that improves visual consistency and in\-game execution.
* Drive end\-to\-end improvements to RuneScape's cosmetic content, increasing its quality, consistency and player\-perceived value while supporting an important commercial area of the game.
* Partner with the Creative, Development and Product Directors, aligning artistic priorities with gameplay goals, production requirements and the wider Road to Restoration.
* Work closely with Technical Art and Engineering, improving pipelines, tools and workflows while balancing creative ambition with the technical realities of a live game across PC and mobile.
* Champion accessibility, readability and player experience, ensuring visual decisions support clear gameplay and remain effective across platforms.
* Represent the art discipline across RuneScape and the wider studio, contributing to recruitment, talent development and the game's long\-term creative strategy.


**What we're looking for:**
* Significant, demonstrable experience in Art Direction or senior art leadership within the games industry, gained on shipped or live titles.
* A proven track record of taking artistic direction from initial vision through to in\-game execution, balancing creative ambition with live\-service schedules, technical limitations and production realities.
* Proven experience leading a sizeable multidisciplinary art team, including managing performance, developing artists and navigating structural or organisational change.
* A strong professional background directing stylised or stylised\-realistic 3D art, supported by demonstrable knowledge of 3D pipelines, production tools, optimisation and technical constraints.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating artistic vision, visual problem\-solving and the ability to establish a consistent quality bar across multiple art disciplines.
* Proven experience joining and improving an established or live game, rather than only defining the direction of new projects from their earliest stages is desired.


**What we offer:**
 When you join Jagex you can look forward to a generous Perks \& Benefits package including:
   

  

* Private Healthcare, including Dental Plan.
* Discretionary annual performance bonus.
* Minimum 6% Pension contributions.
* Life Insurance.
* Enhanced family leave policies from day 1\.
* Flexible working hours.
* 25 days annual leave \+ Bank holidays \& the option to buy/sell holidays \+ so much more!


**Inclusion \& Accessibility** 
**Statement**
 We are committed to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from all backgrounds, and we recruit, develop, and promote based on merit and ability.
   

  

 If you require any reasonable adjustments to support you during the recruitment process, please let us know when you're invited to interview.
   

  

**About Jagex**
 We are Jagex: The RuneScape Company. Home to one of gaming's most enduring success stories. We create deep, community\-powered games with worlds that evolve, inspire, and endure. Our flagship MMORPG franchise, RuneScape, has welcomed over 300 million player accounts, inspiring generations of players across PC and mobile for 25 years.
   

  

 As we begin our 26th year, we are accelerating our strategy to expand RuneScape into a broader ecosystem of forever games and connected experiences, grounded in a renewed commitment to integrity and fair play. This includes the reduction of monetisation mechanics, as well as the launch of RuneScape: DragonWilds into Steam Early Access in 2025, representing a major step in building a multi\-genre future for the RuneScape universe. We remain focused on building enduring worlds, empowering player\-led innovation, and laying the foundations for the boldest era in RuneScape's history. For more information, visit https://www.jagex.com/ .
   

  

 Headquartered in Cambridge, United Kingdom, we are home to passionate creators, storytellers, engineers, and even a few dreamers, all united by a single mission to shape the future of online worlds and empower players to make them their own. We're looking for people to join us who share our ambitions and values. We foster an inclusive workplace built on trust, autonomy, and a shared passion for creating experiences that inspire our communities.
   

  

 Our values guide everything we do: We Embrace Fellowship by collaborating and sharing openly. We Hone our Craft by always learning and improving; We Honour our Vows by being honest and transparent; We are our Customers' Heroes by striving to understand our team \& player needs, and We Seize The Day by making the most of every opportunity.
   

  

 Join us. The next era of RuneScape and the next chapter of Jagex: The RuneScape Company starts now.

title: Design Director
description:
**Design Director** 




**Orangery® — Guildford, Surrey** 




**Full\-time · Hybrid · £62,000–£68,000** 




  





**\-\-\-\-** 




  





**We're a six\-person B\-Corp studio in Guildford looking for a Design Director. A senior, hands\-on creative who can take an idea, elevate it, and drive it through to work we're all proud to put our name on.** 




  





 Around half your time will be spent on a global sports brand moving into brand\-first, social\-first campaign work — brand guidelines, campaign toolkits, and regional and global rollouts. The other half is varied: rebrands, strategic design projects and campaigns for clients across technology and B2B.

Leadership is earned, and it's there to take.
 



  





 Everyone here is senior enough to manage their own work and their own diary, and is trusted to get on with it. No unnecessary layers, no agency politics.
 



  





 We're also early in our AI journey, building it into how we brief, research and produce. If that interests you, it's a good moment to join.

* Presenting and defending work directly to clients

* Around 8\+ years in an agency or studio, with time at senior, lead or director level

* Confident with print artwork and production

* Experience with high\-profile brands and/or complex campaign rollouts
* Figma as your day\-to\-day, alongside advanced Adobe CS. Motion skills an advantage

 to
 
**careers@orangerycreative.com**

title: Head of Brand Design and Creative
description:
**Our mission**
 We're making Africa the first cashless continent.
   

  

 In 2017, over half the population in Sub\-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.
   

  

 We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer\-to\-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.
   

  

 Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...
   

  

****How you'll help us achieve it****
 We’re looking for a Head of Brand Design and Creative who is strategic, thrives for creative excellence and is operationally effective to be responsible for defining Wave’s brand expression at scale. * This is a remote position and can work remotely from anywhere (between UTC \-8 and \+4\) with reliable Internet access.

* 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidised fertility assistance
* Unlimited vacation with a 20\-day minimum requirement

**Requirements**
* 10\+ years of experience in brand design or creative leadership roles
* Experience leading and scaling creative teams in high\-growth environments
* Proven ability to design and implement scalable creative systems and governance frameworks
* Experience operating across multiple markets or regions
* Strong strategic thinking paired with high creative standards

* Are experienced in cross\-functional leadership and influencing senior stakeholders

**Our team**

 Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.
   

  

 We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.
   

  

 Wave is an equal\-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

 We’re looking for a
 **Creative Director** 
 to help define what AI filmmaking can become with Autodesk Flow Studio. This is a rare opportunity to shape both the creative direction of the product itself and the films, experiments, demos, and cultural moments that show the world what it can do.
   

  

 This is an AI\-first, hands\-on creative leadership role embedded within the Flow Studio Product organization. You’ll have significant creative freedom, lead a dedicated content team, work closely with Product leadership, and get hands\-on with emerging AI filmmaking tools and workflows. The work can range from ambitious cinematic showcases and AI films to fast\-moving social experiments designed to earn attention organically.
   

  

 You’ll own the creative bar for everything that lives in or represents the product: the creative look and feel of key product surfaces, cinematic and animation libraries, camera moves, templates and examples, demos, launch storytelling, and other content that helps creators understand what Flow Studio can make possible.
   

  

 You’ll also be the primary product\-side creative partner to Flow Studio Marketing, helping shape concepts, promos, launch videos, campaigns, social content, and other external storytelling. Marketing leads audience, campaign, channel, and brand strategy; this role brings the product’s creative vision, AI filmmaking expertise, cinematic taste, and product truth into the work.
   

  

 The ideal person is already deeply engaged in AI filmmaking, has exceptional visual taste and a strong cinematic eye, understands internet culture and social trends, and wants the freedom and resources to make ambitious work that people actually want to watch.
   

  

**Please submit a portfolio or reel with your application.**
 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Own the creative vision and quality bar for Flow Studio across in\-product creative experiences, cinematic content, libraries, demos, showcases, and product storytelling.
* Lead and develop the Flow Studio content team, setting creative priorities, directing execution, mentoring contributors, and building a team capable of producing exceptional work quickly.
* Create and direct ambitious AI filmmaking work—from cinematic showcases and product films to reference\-quality experiments that push the creative possibilities of Flow Studio.
* Work hands\-on with emerging AI image, video, performance, animation, and filmmaking tools; prototype new ideas, test new models and techniques, and turn experimentation into finished creative work.
* Shape the creative layer of the product itself, including cinematic and animation libraries, camera moves, examples, templates, onboarding content, reusable scene elements, and other creator\-facing experiences.
* Bring strong filmmaking judgment to camera, composition, lighting, performance, pacing, editing, visual treatment, and storytelling across the work.
* Partner closely with Product, Design, and Engineering from early feature development through launch, translating new capabilities into compelling creative experiences and demonstrations.
* Act as the primary product\-side creative partner to Marketing for launches, campaigns, promotional films, social, web, events, and other external storytelling—helping shape concepts, scripts, storyboards, visuals, and execution.
* Identify opportunities around emerging AI, filmmaking, and social trends, and create culturally relevant, internet\-native work that is distinctive, timely, highly shareable, and capable of earning meaningful organic reach.
* Build lightweight creative standards, reusable assets, and production practices that help the team maintain a very high bar without slowing down experimentation.


**Qualifications**
* Exceptional portfolio or reel demonstrating outstanding cinematic taste, storytelling, and creative direction.
* Deep, hands\-on experience with AI filmmaking and modern generative creative tools, with a strong understanding of the rapidly evolving image, video, performance, animation, and AI production landscape.
* Strong filmmaking instincts across camera, composition, lighting, performance, pacing, editing, and visual storytelling. Cinematography or directing experience is a major plus.
* Proven ability to originate and create ambitious cinematic work—not only manage or review the work of others.
* Strong understanding of viral, social, and internet\-native content, with sharp awareness of emerging social media trends, formats, platforms, and online culture. Demonstrated experience creating or directing work that has earned meaningful organic reach, audience engagement, or cultural traction.
* Experience leading creative teams, giving direct and constructive feedback, and maintaining a consistently high creative bar.
* Comfort working closely with Product and Engineering teams and turning emerging technology and complex product capabilities into compelling creative ideas, demonstrations, and experiences.

 Gamma is used by millions of people every day to create, teach, and persuade. But our brand is just getting started. As Creative Director, you'll build and lead Gamma's creative function while staying deeply hands\-on as a designer yourself.
   

  

 Your mandate is to take Gamma's brand from beloved prosumer tool to a platform trusted by Fortune 100 companies and solo creators alike. With 80% of our users outside the United States, you'll own how Gamma translates across cultures, languages, and business contexts, ensuring the brand resonates everywhere without losing its personality. You'll manage and grow a distributed design team, collaborate closely with a creative team of marketers, and bring cohesion and quality standards across time zones and disciplines.
   

  

 Our team has a strong in\-office culture and works in person 4–5 days per week in San Francisco. We love working together to stay creative and connected, with flexibility to work from home when focus matters most.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Design. Every day. Own creative output for Gamma's highest\-visibility moments, from product launches and brand campaigns to enterprise sales materials — set the quality bar by producing the work, not just approving it
* Manage and elevate a distributed design team while collaborating with marketers on campaigns and brand initiatives. Hire new designers as the team grows
* Drive AI\-first creative production by building repeatable workflows for ideation, asset production, and iteration across your team
* Own Gamma's brand identity and visual systems across every surface: marketing, social, events, and sales collateral to scale the brand from prosumer delight to B2B credibility
* Develop creative strategies that serve Gamma's full audience spectrum, from individual creators to Fortune 100 decision\-makers, adapting tone and visual approach while keeping the brand cohesive
* Build frameworks that let regional teams produce on\-brand work at speed, and lead localized creative for key markets across AMER, LATAM, EMEA, and APAC


**What You'll Bring**
* 8\+ years of creative experience at an agency or in\-house brand\-forward company, with a portfolio showing hands\-on design craft and strategic brand thinking
* Active, daily fluency with AI creative tools and a clear point of view on how they transform creative production
* Experience managing distributed creative teams and collaborating cross\-functionally with marketers, PMs, and product designers
* Proven ability to hire and develop creative talent — you know what great looks like and can attract designers who raise the bar

description:
**Project:** Brand Development \+ Launch Creative Direction  
**Engagement:** Freelance / Contract  
**Initial term:** Approximately 6\-8 weeks  
**Industry:** Beauty / Hair / Luxury Services  
**Location:** Norcross, GA; hybrid/remote possible, with some in\-person availability preferred

About Tresse

Tresse is a new elevated braid bar created to modernize the traditional braiding experience.

Our goal is not simply to provide beautiful braids. Tresse is being built around a more polished, reliable and thoughtfully designed client experience—combining exceptional braiding with efficiency, comfort, professionalism and hospitality.

We want Tresse to feel like a **beauty brand that happens to specialize in braiding**, rather than simply another braid salon.

We are seeking a freelance Creative Director to help translate that vision into a distinctive and recognizable brand.

**The Assignment**

The Creative Director will work directly with the founder to establish the creative world of Tresse and develop the visual and experiential direction for its launch.

The goal is **not to completely reinvent the existing concept**. Tresse already has an initial identity and direction. We are looking for someone who can refine it, challenge it where appropriate, and develop it into a sophisticated and cohesive brand system.

The Creative Director should help answer:

**What should someone see, feel and immediately understand when they encounter Tresse?**

**Scope \& Deliverables**

The project will focus on six areas:

**1\. Brand Creative Direction**  
Develop the overarching creative concept and visual world for Tresse, including mood, visual references, typography direction, color application, graphic treatments and imagery.

**2\. Brand Identity Refinement**  
Evaluate the existing Tresse logo, black\-and\-gold direction and other brand elements. Recommend refinements where necessary while developing a more ownable visual identity.

**3\. Brand Voice \& Messaging**  
Establish guidelines for how Tresse communicates across social media, website/booking, advertising, client communications and physical signage.

This should include how we communicate the idea of **elevated braiding** without relying on generic luxury language.

**4\. Client Experience Creative Direction**  
Help translate the brand into the physical experience—including salon environment, signage, client amenities, refreshments, presentation, uniforms/smocks, packaging and other touchpoints.

**5\. Launch Campaign \+ Content Direction**  
Develop the creative concept for Tresse's launch, including social media direction, launch storytelling, campaign concepts and initial content pillars.

**6\. Launch Photoshoot Direction**  
Develop the concept and shot list and help direct the visual execution of Tresse's launch photography/video, including models, hairstyles, wardrobe, styling, composition and overall visual treatment.

At the conclusion of the project, the Creative Director should provide a comprehensive **Tresse Creative/Brand Playbook** documenting the final direction so future photographers, designers, social\-media managers and other creatives can execute the brand consistently.

It should include things such as approved visual direction, typography/color usage, imagery direction, photography guidelines, brand voice, social/content direction, graphic treatments, examples of correct/incorrect execution and launch creative direction.

**Who We're Looking For**

We are especially interested in creative directors with experience in **beauty, fashion, luxury consumer brands, hospitality, wellness or culturally relevant lifestyle brands**.

Prior salon experience is not required.

We are looking for someone with strong taste, but more importantly, someone who understands **brand strategy and can explain the reasoning behind creative decisions**.

The ideal candidate is comfortable challenging ideas when there is an opportunity to make the brand more distinctive.

Please do not apply with only logo/graphic\-design examples. We would like to see complete brand or campaign work demonstrating concept development, creative direction and execution.

Pay: $2,500\.00 \- $4,000\.00 per year

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Us**
 There’s a reason HUNTER is recognized as a PRWeek Best Place To Work and has been named PRovoke “Consumer Agency of the Year” not once, but twice: At HUNTER, we EARN IT — consumer attention, the trust and loyalty of clients, and the dedication of our staff, currently 350\+ strong and counting.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Creative Director is a proven creative leader who consistently develops disruptive, culture\-shaping ideas that cut through and drive earned\-worthy moments for clients. Leading an integrated Art and Copy team, you bring both conceptual rigor and the self\-editing skills to shape campaigns with minimal oversight. You thrive as a hands\-on creative, formulating bold ideas on brief, directing executions, and presenting directly to clients with confidence and clarity. As an emerging leader, you mentor and elevate your team while demonstrating the creative maturity and strategic thinking that positions you as the next generation of creative leadership at HUNTER.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Creative Leadership \& Idea Development**

* Translate complex briefs and strategy into clear creative direction; understand and appreciate the importance of strategy and ensure all ideas ladder to client business objectives
* Lead creative concepting, brainstorms, and strategy sessions with energy and conviction, fostering bold thinking and pushing boundaries within strategic intent
* Concept and direct across disciplines; developing storyboards, comps, copy, and integrated executions that showcase creative excellence

* Foster a collaborative team culture where bold ideas are encouraged, feedback is constructive and respectful, and exceptional work is celebrated
* Conduct project\-based performance feedback and contribute to formal performance review processes; support career development and growth
* Demonstrate maturity in navigating challenging client situations, finding creative opportunities even within difficult constraints
* Collaborate with flexibility and confidence to build account team and client trust and ensure satisfaction while maintaining HUNTER's creative standards
* Identify growth opportunities with existing clients; support account expansion through strong creative work and strategic thinking


**New Business \& Agency Growth**

* Bring thoughtful, fresh, and strategic ideas to new business opportunities; demonstrate the energy and enthusiasm that wins pitches

**Budgeting and Finance**
* Track team members hours/rates and OOP costs against budget and work with the ECD to manage billability and useability across the team
* Establish a clear line of communication with account teams, ECD and COO with respect to scoping and pricing models for all projects
* Work with account/HR/Finance team on all vendor agreements, ensuring competitive bids are met and costs are appropriate for the size and scale of the project
* Manage all vendor contracts, and insurance (both freelance and production vendor)


**Qualifications**
* 6\-10\+ years of creative leadership, with proven success leading multidisciplinary teams in integrated marketing, brand experiences, or communications
* Exceptional portfolio demonstrating conceptual strength, visual storytelling, and integrated campaign execution
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute innovative campaigns that drive engagement and measurable results
* Record of winning new business and expanding existing client relationships


**Leadership \& People Skills**
* Ability to mentor, coach, and develop creative talent; model strong leadership through clear direction, constructive feedback, and empowerment
* Proven experience managing and inspiring cross\-functional teams across design, content strategy, production, and account management
* Strong communication and presentation skills; confidence when presenting to clients, stakeholders, and executive leadership
* Sharp collaboration and active listening skills, with the ability to align teams and stakeholders around shared vision


**Strategic \& Operational Mindset**
* Strong strategic thinking: ability to dissect briefs, uncover insights, and translate business objectives into compelling creative solutions
* Hands\-on expertise overseeing multiple complex projects at various stages while maintaining high\-level strategic oversight
* Experience managing budgets, resources, and freelance partnerships; commitment to executing projects efficiently and profitably

Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.
   

  

 At HUNTER, we work hard and play hard, and while we have all the benefits you’d expect —competitive health and dental insurance plans, a 401K company match and generous PTO — we also provide:
   

  

* a hybrid work model;
* a “work from anywhere in the US” policy (up to four weeks a year);
* a year\-round staff training and development curriculum; and
* a staff\-led Action Group dedicated to DEI excellence in the agency and industry (read our DEI statement here: https://hunterpr.com/dei/ )


 Perks? We have perks. When you work at HUNTER, you can expect Bring Your Parents (And Kids) to Work Days, regular volunteer Days of Service, mid\-day Cupcakes and Cocktails mixers and epic Halloween and holiday parties.
   

  

 Founded in 1989, HUNTER has grown into one of the most respected mid\-size marketing communications firms in the country, creating work that matters in strategic planning, earned media relations, social and digital media, talent and influencer engagement, experiential marketing, multicultural outreach and content creation and distribution. And we do it all for esteemed companies and brands across every sector you can imagine:
   

  

* Food \+ Beverage
* Wine \+ Spirits
* Health \+ Wellness
* Beauty \+ Personal Care \+ Fashion
* Home \+ Lifestyle \+ Travel
* Retail \+ E\-commerce


 See us in action here: https://hunterpr.com
