title: IT Business Analyst - LIMS Process Expert
description:
**Company Description** ***Why are we here?***


Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.


Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.

 **Job Description** **In a nutshell**


As a **Business Analyst, expert in LIMS Processes,** you will support our in‑house chromatography data processing application. You will translate laboratory and business requirements into clear deliverables, optimize analytical workflows for quality and efficiency, and ensure compliance with major EU environmental testing laboratory standards.


You’ will partner with laboratory leaders, product and engineering teams, finance, and commercial stakeholders to standardize processes and guide delivery of features that streamline instrument data capture, processing, quality control (QC), technical review, and reporting across hyphenated and non\-hyphenated analytical workflows (gas chromatography GC, liquid chromatography LC, inductively coupled plasma ICP and mass spectrometry (MS).

**Where will you be based and what business will you support?**

* Build and maintain strong relationships across operations, R\&D, quality, IT, and commercial units.

* Map current vs. future‑state EU laboratory workflows; identify gaps, risks, and compliance needs.

**Requirements \& Key Skills**

-----------

  

**The Opportunity**

  

Hyatt is looking for an Associate Manager, CRM , Digital Campaigns \& Projects to join the Digital \& Direct Channel team in Palma de Mallorca, Spain, working under a hybrid model.


In this role, you will contribute to the growth of Hyatt’s direct channels through the planning, execution, and optimization of CRM and digital campaigns, as well as the coordination of projects related to the digital and web experience. Our purpose is to care for people so they can be their best. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

Looking for a HVAC Maintenance Technician opportunity at a place you can make a difference every day? Discover this great opportunity in our Diego Garcia location. Bring your expertise and collaborative skills to make an impact towards our military defense and safety of our sailors by discovering your new role supporting this critical mission.  

**This position is contingent upon your ability to obtain/maintain/transfer your Secret clearance.**
As the HVAC Maintenance Technician in Diego Garcia, Serco\-NA, in conjunction with the United States Space Force (USSF) are responsible for tracking all man\-made objects in orbit. This mission is vital to keeping existing satellites safe and to provide critical information to organizations launching new satellites in the future. One of the assets USSF uses to accomplish this mission is the Ground\-Based Electro\-Optical Deep Space Surveillance (GEODSS) System.


This optical sensor is employed at three (3\) different locations around the world (White Sands Missile Range, New Mexico; Diego Garcia, British Indian Ocean Territory; and Maui, Hawaii) and helps track the objects in deep space orbit (altitude of 10,000 to 45,000 km).


Come join the team that provides this service to United States. You will help operate and maintain three (3\), one\-meter telescopes equipped with highly sensitive digital cameras. You’ll respond to Government tasking to obtain metric observations of specific objects daily and help maintain the sensors, support equipment, and the facility that houses it at Detachment 2, Naval Support Facility in Diego Garcia, British Indian Ocean Territory (BIOT).


This is a unique work\-site, so being a part of the Serco\-NA GEODSS Team, you will be offered Special Incentives:


* Free Internet,
* Meal allowances,
* Competitive salaries,
* Retention Bonus,
* Paid Time\-Off, and many more.

In this role, you will:


* Test, inspect, maintain, and repair assigned facilities, equipment, and systems in accordance with Operating Instructions (OIs), Preventive Maintenance Instructions (PMIs), manufacturer's instructions, specifications, drawings, and other applicable documents.

* Maintain and update RPIE drawings.
* Respond to emergency conditions within two hours and eliminate condition within 24 hours.
* Act as Backflow Prevention Manager; Implement a cross connection and backflow prevention program; inspect, test, install, repair and replace backflow prevention devices.
* Maintain HVAC systems.
* Perform duties as Equipment Custodian.

* Must be able to lift and carry up to 30 pounds.

  

To be successful in this role, you will have:


* The ability to obtain/maintain an Active DoD Secret Security clearance.

	+ If performing the duties of the heating/plumbing mechanic, must have 3 years experience in the operation, maintenance, and repair of heating and plumbing systems.

* Completion of accredited trade school in heating/plumbing mechanic.
* Must be able to work shift duty due to 24/7 operations environment.
* Must be able to lift and carry up to 30 pounds.

  

Additional desired experience and skills:
* Top Secret Preferred

description:

* Te integrarás en una cultura basada en el **respeto, la integridad y la responsabilidad**.

**TITULACIÓN / ESTUDIOS**


✓ Ingeniería de Telecomunicación (especialidad en Electrónica), Ingeniería Electrónica o titulación equivalente.

**COMPETENCIAS**


✓ Conocimiento sólido sobre el funcionamiento y diseño de circuitos digitales.


✓ Experiencia en programación de dispositivos de lógica programable mediante lenguajes **VHDL y/o Verilog**.


✓ Conocimiento y experiencia demostrable en herramientas de desarrollo de los principales fabricantes de FPGA, especialmente **Intel (Altera)** y **AMD (Xilinx)**.


✓ Experiencia en simulación y verificación de circuitos digitales para su implementación en FPGA.


✓ Desarrollo e integración de interfaces y protocolos de comunicación como **UART, USB, Ethernet**, entre otros.


✓ Conocimiento y experiencia en el uso de equipamiento de laboratorio electrónico: osciloscopios, analizadores lógicos, generadores de señal, fuentes de alimentación, etc.


✓ Conocimiento de sistemas embebidos basados en microprocesadores.


✓ Conocimientos de programación en **Python** y **MATLAB**.


✓ Capacidad para trabajar eficazmente en equipos multidisciplinares.

**IDIOMAS**


✓ Buen nivel de inglés, tanto hablado como escrito.

**RESPONSABILIDADES**


✓ Diseñar y desarrollar las arquitecturas sobre las que se implementan los sistemas de visión artificial de la compañía.


✓ Contribuir al desarrollo de soluciones embebidas de hardware y hardware\-software, dando soporte a aplicaciones de visión artificial que se ejecutan en los Sistemas de Visión en un Chip (SoC) desarrollados internamente.


✓ Participar en la validación de los sistemas de visión desarrollados en Teledyne mediante el testado en placa de modelos HDL representativos de los diseños implementados en silicio.


✓ Desarrollar plataformas de test y entornos de simulación de circuitos a nivel de sistema para realizar verificaciones funcionales y análisis de tiempos de respuesta.


✓ Colaborar con equipos multidisciplinares para garantizar la correcta integración y validación de las soluciones desarrolladas.

**ENGLISH**


We are looking for an **FPGA Design Engineer** to join our team and contribute to the design, development, and validation of advanced hardware architectures for computer vision systems. The successful candidate will work in a highly specialized technological environment, collaborating closely with multidisciplinary teams across IC design, hardware, software, and validation.

**About Us**


At Teledyne Sevilla, you will join a team where innovation, human values, and work\-life balance go hand in hand:

* You will contribute to the development of **cutting\-edge computer vision technologies**.
* You will be part of an **innovation\-driven and continuous improvement environment**.
* You will develop your career in a **human\-scale organization**, where your contribution truly matters.

* You will join a culture built on **respect, integrity, and accountability**.

**EDUCATION**


✓ Degree in Telecommunications Engineering (specialization in Electronics), Electronic Engineering, or a related field.

**SKILLS**


✓ Strong knowledge of digital circuit operation and design.


✓ Experience programming programmable logic devices using **VHDL and/or Verilog**.


✓ Proven experience with FPGA development tools from major vendors, particularly **Intel (Altera)** and **AMD (Xilinx)**.


✓ Experience in simulation and verification of digital circuits for FPGA implementation.


✓ Development and integration of communication interfaces and protocols such as **UART, USB, Ethernet**, and others.


✓ Knowledge and practical experience using electronic laboratory equipment, including oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, signal generators, power supplies, and related instruments.


✓ Knowledge of microprocessor\-based embedded systems.


✓ Programming knowledge of **Python** and **MATLAB**.


✓ Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams.

**LANGUAGES**


✓ Good command of English, both written and spoken.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**


✓ Design and develop the architectures that support the company's computer vision systems.


✓ Contribute to the development of embedded hardware and hardware\-software solutions supporting computer vision applications running on the company's internally developed Vision Systems\-on\-Chip (SoCs).


✓ Support the validation of Teledyne vision systems through board\-level testing of HDL models representative of silicon implementations.


✓ Develop test platforms and system\-level circuit simulation environments for functional verification and timing analysis.


✓ Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure the successful integration and validation of developed solutions.

  



Teledyne and all of our employees are committed to conducting business with the highest ethical standards. We require all employees to comply with all applicable laws, regulations, rules and regulatory orders. Our reputation for honesty, integrity and high ethics is as important to us as our reputation for making innovative sensing solutions.

title: Head of Growth
description:
**Head of Growth:
   

  

**Company:****
 SimpleStudy is where students go to learn and connect. The Strava for School. The company just closed a $4M seed round, with 1\.5M \+ students across five primary markets: UK, Ireland, Brazil, South Africa, and Australia. Over \~40,000 new students join every week. The team is \~20 people, operating remotely with an office in Lisbon.
   

  

 Notable investors include the first investors in Facebook and Revolut, as well as the founders of Strava and Intercom. The company is lean, product\-obsessed, and deliberately not a typical education company — it's built consumer\-first, with heavy PLG and A/B testing culture. 1 in 4 students in Ireland already use the product, and they want to do that for several hundred million students around the world.
   

  

****Who We're Looking For****
 Whether you're an Ex\-founder, built entire business lines, led teams, or scaled something before that ended in flames. We’re interested in someone who wants to be at the table, leading growth across the business, enabling us to capitalise on the PMF that we’ve found, and exploit the opportunities we’ve already created. SimpleStudy has achieved breakout success in an industry defined by difficulty, and now we’re looking for someone to convert founder\-led PMF into an operationally excellent organisation that can scale. Someone who doesn’t want to be a cog in a machine, but actually put the machine together and steer it.
   

  

****Why Join Us?****
* You’d like to work directly with the company's founders, in a highly trusted role with complete transparency across the company.
* Broken things piss you off, and you want to have the authority to make things that work. Be rewarded for systematisation, have the freedom to fix things where other companies shrug.
* You want to work with amazing people who mutually challenge each other, who want you to be the best version of yourself, professionally and personally.
* You want to work in a venture\-backed startup that is aiming for ludicrous success and an extreme outlier outcome, while building a better world with a platform that helps millions of young people.
* You want to work alongside the leadership team in person in Lisbon—young people who value energy, excellence, creativity, problem\-solving, fitness, and respect.


****What you'll do****
* Work directly with the founder (me) to run half the company, set defaults, and transform it. Where harder problems come up, you point the founder at problems to crack them.
* Own all growth teams and channels across all markets.
* Organise, operationalise, systematise, process, \-wizardise your domains into a highly functional, well\-oiled machine.
* Manage team leads, challenge them, set objectives, create reports and roadmaps, and define goals.
* Think critically about how a multi\-channel, multi\-team growth organisation can be built and run in an AI\-native environment.
* Build a machine that moves fast, clean, and smooth, that knows where it is and why. Where there are easy wins, we chase them and exploit them. Where there’s basics, you make sure we’re already doing them. Where there should be process, you’ve defined them; where there are team roadmaps, you greenlight them. Where there should be hierarchy of focus, you set it. Where you’re doing too much, you know how to get your team’s to step up and can show them the way.


****What You Need****
* Existing understanding of growth pillars and channels in modern software businesses
* Experience in either consumer or multi\-channel marketing\-heavy businesses.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in startup roles with similar skills.
* Proven experience in messy, fast\-moving, early\-stage startup.
* Demonstrable ability to distil complexity and reduce noise into clear steps and systems you’re responsible for running smoothly.
* Exceptional communication and leadership skills that are natural to you.
* Discipline in organisational skills and ensuring it from others.
* Brutally high standards. You have discernment and taste; you know when something is mid and say it.
* Systems thinking for what we are actually doing, why, how, measurement, cadence, who’s accountable, when it is done, repeatably across the org.
* Strong commercial, business\-driven heuristics for decision\-making.
* Intrapersonal skills and experience managing others.


**Details:**
 Top of Market compensation and equity.
   

  

 Compensation Range: $60K \- $130K

title: Portfolio Director
description:
**Portfolio Director \- Exhibitions**

**Hybrid:** Herne Hill, 3 days in the office  

**Reporting to:** Managing Director, MA Exhibitions  

**Direct reports:** 5  

**Contract:** Permanent, full\-time


At Mark Allen, we create specialist content, events, data and insight for professional communities across sectors that matter.


As **Portfolio Director,** you will be responsible for accelerating commercial growth and performance across an established seven\-event portfolio generating **£7m turnover**. This is a senior leadership role with clear accountability for portfolio strategy, revenue, new product development and commercial performance.


The role has been created to give the division dedicated senior leadership and the commercial focus needed for its next stage of growth. A central priority is **identifying**, **developing** and successfully **launching** new exhibitions and products, alongside growing and strengthening the existing portfolio.


You will lead senior commercial people, work closely with marketing and operations, and make clear, evidence\-based decisions on where to invest, where to evolve and where to stop.


This role requires a leader who can combine strategic portfolio ownership with strong commercial execution, creating sustainable growth from established exhibitions while building the next generation of products.

**Commercial Growth and Portfolio Strategy**

* Own the division's strategy and commercial performance, with accountability for revenue and gross profit growth.
* Develop long\-term growth plans across existing exhibitions, new launches, brands and people.
* Create the annual business plan and budget using robust market, customer and competitor analysis.
* Make clear decisions on where to invest, evolve, accelerate or stop, based on evidence and commercial return.
* Identify opportunities to grow organically through existing products and new propositions.

**New Exhibition and Product Development**

* Lead the identification and development of new exhibition opportunities within relevant markets.
* Build robust commercial cases for new launches, including audience need, competitor position, revenue potential, cost and route to market.
* Take new exhibitions from concept to launch, setting clear milestones, ownership and commercial targets.
* Test propositions with customers and market stakeholders, adapting quickly where evidence requires it.
* Establish post\-launch growth plans and hold teams accountable for delivering against them.

**Sales Leadership and Performance**

* Lead 5 senior commercial direct reports and create a high\-performance, accountable sales culture.
* Set ambitious sales goals and work with leaders to deliver monthly, event and rebooking targets.
* Use pipelines, KPIs, and trading data to assess performance, improve sales effectiveness, and intervene early when results are off track.
* Coach senior commercial leaders, raise standards and address underperformance clearly and constructively.

**Market and Customer Leadership**

* Act as a senior figurehead for MA Exhibitions within the markets served by the division.
* Build strong relationships with customers, associations, partners and key stakeholders.
* Ensure each exhibition has clear market positioning, a strong customer proposition and a plan to improve customer satisfaction.

**Must\-haves**

* 10\+ years' experience in the exhibition industry, including senior leadership responsibility.
* Proven responsibility for multiple exhibitions or brands and significant commercial or P\&L outcomes.
* A demonstrable track record of personally launching new exhibitions and taking them from concept to commercial delivery.
* Evidence of delivering revenue and gross profit growth across an established portfolio.
* Strong experience leading senior sales and commercial people, raising performance and addressing underperformance.
* Strong business planning, budgeting, forecasting and KPI management capability.
* The gravitas to build and influence senior industry and stakeholder relationships.
* A commercial growth leader with deep exhibition industry experience.
* A proven record of taking new exhibitions from concept through to successful launch.
* Comfortable owning a significant multi\-event portfolio and making clear investment decisions.
* A strong sales leader who can raise performance and address underperformance directly.
* Strategic enough to shape the portfolio, but practical and close enough to the market to deliver.

**Our values translated in this role**


Mark Allen Group is a values\-led business. We are looking for a Portfolio Director who delivers ambitious commercial growth in a way that reflects our values:

**Passionate –** Brings pace, ownership and commercial ambition to driving portfolio growth

**Creative –** Spots market opportunities, challenges established approaches and turns strong ideas into viable new exhibitions and products.

**Nurturing –** Develops commercial leaders, raises standards and builds capability, confidence and accountability across the team.

**Fair –** Makes balanced, transparent decisions, sets clear expectations and addresses performance consistently and constructively.

**What this looks like in practice**

* Own the growth plan for a significant established portfolio and stay personally accountable for results.
* Use market and customer insight to identify opportunities and make clear investment decisions.
* Turn credible ideas into new exhibition launches with disciplined commercial cases, milestones and targets.
* Set clear expectations across senior sales leaders, use data to manage performance and address underperformance early.
* Develop commercial leaders by giving direction, honest feedback and meaningful ownership.
* Balance pace and ambition with transparent decisions, customer value and long\-term portfolio health.

**Why join Mark Allen Group?**

* Take ownership of an established portfolio generating **£7m turnover**, with a clear mandate to accelerate growth.
* Shape and launch the next generation of exhibitions and products, with real autonomy and accountability.
* Lead experienced commercial people and influence the future direction of a significant part of MA Exhibitions.
* Be part of a specialist media and events business with strong, trusted brands and long\-term ambition.


For over 40 years, Mark Allen Group has built and grown specialist media brands that inform, connect and support professional communities. We operate across healthcare, education, agriculture, business, finance, travel retail, exhibitions and critical communications, combining trusted content, data, events and insight.


We are a commercial media owner with a long\-term mindset, balancing strong legacy brands with innovation and evolution. Our people play a central role in shaping how our audiences engage with us today and how we grow for the future.

**We offer:**

* Hybrid working.
* Real ownership in your role.
* Development through hands\-on learning, mentoring and internal progression.
* Company benefits.
* Exposure to specialist markets and loyal professional audiences.
* A culture shaped by our values

**How to apply**


Apply through our careers site with your CV, including a **cover letter** sharing what attracted you to the role and what you would bring to it.


A video introduction is **completely optional** and will not disadvantage your application.

**Right to work:** Applicants must have the legal right to live and work in the **UK**. Unfortunately, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

title: Director, Digital Product Design- HP IQ
description:
**Description \-**
**Who We Are**
 HP IQ is HP’s new AI innovation lab. Combining startup agility with HP’s global scale, we’re building intelligent technologies that redefine how the world works, creates, and collaborates.
   

  

 We’re assembling a diverse, world\-class team—engineers, designers, researchers, and product minds—focused on creating an intelligent ecosystem across HP’s portfolio. Together, we’re developing intuitive, adaptive solutions that spark creativity, boost productivity, and make collaboration seamless.
   

  

 We create breakthrough solutions that make complex tasks feel effortless, teamwork more natural, and ideas more impactful—always with a human\-centric mindset.
   

  

 By embedding AI advancements into every HP product and service, we’re expanding what’s possible for individuals, organisations, and the future of work.
   

  

 Join us as we reinvent work, so people everywhere can do their best work.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The IQ Design team creates simple, delightful, and transformative user experiences. We're a team of product designers, design engineers, and systems thinkers exploring what computing looks like when it truly works for people. Our work spans new hardware platforms, new software experiences, and the emerging spaces between them.
   

  

 This is a design\-led group. Design doesn't support product development here; it drives it. We have strong opinions about what makes an experience worth using, and we expect leadership that shares that conviction. The person in this role will set the bar for quality, advocate for the user when priorities compete, and make the case (again and again, if needed) that craft is not a nice\-to\-have.
   

  

 We're looking for a Director of Digital Product Design to lead this team. You'll manage and grow a group of senior designers and design engineers, setting the creative direction for how our software looks, feels, and behaves. This isn't a role where you disappear into strategy decks. You'll stay close to the work, shaping the culture of a team that prototypes fast, cares deeply about craft, and ships products that matter.
   

  

 The right person for this role believes that great design teams are built, not assembled. You'll have significant autonomy to define how your team works together: the rituals, the critique culture, the way ideas move from exploration to production. You care as much about creating the conditions for other people to do their best work as you do about the work itself. You know how to build trust across disciplines, protect creative space, and still hold a high bar for what ships.
   

  

 This is also a role for someone who understands that AI is fundamentally changing how design gets done, not just what we design but how we design it. Your team will be AI\-native designers who use tools like Claude, Cursor, and Codex as part of their daily workflow. You should be fluent enough in LLMs and generative AI to have strong opinions about where these tools accelerate great work and where they undermine it.
   

  

 What You Might Do
   

  

* Lead, hire, and grow a team of senior product designers, design engineers, and intelligent systems designers working across HP's software experiences
* Define and evolve the creative direction for software design across HP's current and future product lines
* Build team culture intentionally: critique practices, collaboration norms, and creative rituals that bring out the best in your people
* Drive the design point of view. Ensure that experience quality is treated as a first\-class priority, not something that gets negotiated away under pressure
* Partner with engineering, AI/ML, hardware, and product leadership to ensure design has appropriately shaped the work from strategy through shipping
* Create space for deep exploratory work while maintaining accountability for shipping cadence and product quality
* Guide the team's adoption of AI\-native design workflows, helping designers and design engineers integrate LLMs and generative tools into prototyping, iteration, and production
* Mentor leads and seniors, supporting their growth and helping them navigate the ambiguity that comes with designing for emerging technology
* Champion design craft across the organization: the motion, the typography, the micro\-interactions that make experiences feel alive
* Represent the team's work and perspective to senior leadership, translating design decisions into language that builds organizational conviction


**Essential Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of experience in digital product design, with at least 3 years managing and growing design teams
* A portfolio (or body of work) that demonstrates both personal design excellence and the ability to elevate the output of a team
* Proven experience shipping AI\-powered or otherwise technically complex consumer products
* Working knowledge of LLMs, how they work, what they're good at, where they break down, and a clear point of view on how tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and similar AI\-assisted workflows are reshaping the practice of software design
* Strong technical fluency. You don't need to write production code, but you should be able to have substantive conversations with engineers about architecture, feasibility, and implementation tradeoffs
* Track record of building healthy, high\-performing team cultures where people do career\-defining work
* Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to bring clarity and direction to undefined problem spaces
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to build conviction across disciplines and levels of seniority


**Preferred Skills**
* Hands\-on experience prototyping with tools like SwiftUI, React, Origami, or AI or web technologies, enough to evaluate and guide the work of design engineers
* Background working in design\-led organizations where design and engineering are deeply integrated rather than siloed
* Experience designing AI\-first systems: memory, personalization, generative interfaces, conversational or agentic experiences
* Familiarity with motion design, animation principles, and the craft details that differentiate good software from great software
* Experience building or scaling design systems, component libraries, and shared design infrastructure
* Interest in the intersection of digital and physical product experiences
* Background in creative coding, computational design, or experimental interface work

This is an individual contributor role: you will not have direct reports, but you will lead and encourage a matrixed, cross\-functional team—engineering, design, data science, and commercial—through vision, influence, and clarity. You will identify whitespace, validate opportunities directly with end users and customers, ship V1 products, and iterate relentlessly—embedding AI and machine learning into every layer of the product build, maintenance, and experience, and driving connectivity across Evinova’s modules so workflows flow seamlessly for clinical development and clinical operations teams. This role requires a builder who thrives in ambiguity and brings the conviction to create something new within a world\-class life sciences software organization.


**What you’ll do**
------------------


**BUILD AN AI\-NATIVE PRODUCT FROM ZERO TO ONE**


* Define and own the product vision, strategy, and multi\-year roadmap for an AI\-native product, from first principles through scale.
* Develop a deep, first\-hand understanding of our users, their problem spaces, and their day\-to\-day workflows—pinpointing where the product can deliver step\-function impact rather than incremental gains.
* Drive rapid hypothesis validation through prototyping and experimentation.
* Own the full product lifecycle end\-to\-end: from concept and design through development, launch, go\-to\-market, and post\-launch iteration informed by usage data and customer feedback.

**Lead AI\-Native product development**
---------------------------------------


* Architect the product with AI and machine learning at its core—for example: intelligent automation, contextual recommendations, predictive insights, and generative AI–powered workflows that reduce effort for end users.
* Collaborate closely with data science and engineering teams to translate ground breaking AI capabilities into practical, regulation\-aware product features.
* Design for the end user first—building intuitive, collaborative workflows that reduce burden and enable clinical development and clinical operations teams to work seamlessly together, with connectivity across Evinova’s modules.
* Meet users where they are and guide them through their change management journey—earning adoption by easing the transition to new, AI\-enabled ways of working rather than forcing it.
* Maintain a sharp point of view on the evolving clinical trial and AI landscape—proactively finding opportunities to apply emerging capabilities to the challenges faced by clinical development and clinical operations teams.

**Drive strategic leadership across Evinova**
---------------------------------------------


* Partner with a matrixed product organization to drive connectivity across Evinova’s modules and inform the product roadmap. Partner with commercial to ensure the product does not over\-fit to any one customer. Iterate relentlessly in pursuit of product\-market fit.
* Serve as the strategic product leader across the organization, aligning engineering, design, data science, and commercial around a unified product vision.
* Communicate product strategy, progress, and trade\-offs to Evinova’s executive leadership and key enterprise customers.
* Define and own success metrics—adoption, engagement, revenue contribution, clinical trial cycle\-time reduction—and drive data\-informed prioritization.

**Operate with entrepreneurial ownership**
------------------------------------------


* Treat your product area as your own business—own the P\&L outlook, make resource trade\-offs, and drive measurable commercial outcomes.
* Navigate the tension between speed\-to\-market and regulatory compliance (GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, GDPR, HIPAA).
* Cultivate strategic partnerships with data providers and standards bodies (CDISC, HL7 FHIR) to accelerate Evinova’s product capabilities.
* Champion a culture of experimentation, intellectual integrity, and continuous learning within your product area and across the broader Evinova team.

**What you bring**
------------------


**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE**


* 8\+ years of product management experience
* Bachelor's Degree
* Demonstrated experience of at least 3 years in a director\-level or senior product leadership capacity owning a product area end\-to\-end.
* Domain experience in clinical trials or life sciences. You bring a deep understanding of the clinical development and clinical operations personas, know the clinical ecosystem (EDC, CDMS, CTMS, eTMF), and can engage credibly with clinical operations leaders, medical directors, biostatisticians, data managers, and regulatory professionals.
* Demonstrated entrepreneurial track record: you have taken at least one product from zero to one—as a founder, early\-stage PM, or intrapreneur within a larger organization. You can point to products you conceived, shipped, and scaled.
* Deep, hands\-on experience building AI/ML\-powered products. You understand model development lifecycles, training data strategies, prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, and the unique UX challenges of AI\-driven features. AI fluency is non\-negotiable for this role.
* Proven ability to operate in enterprise B2B SaaS environments, including navigating complex customer landscapes, long sales cycles, and platform\-level product decisions.
* Strong technical skill: comfortable partnering directly with engineers and data scientists, reviewing technical specifications, and contributing to architectural trade\-off decisions.

**AI Fluency Expectations**
---------------------------


* You use AI tools daily in your own workflow—for research, analysis, writing, prototyping, and decision\-making—and can articulate how AI is transforming product development practices.
* You can evaluate AI/ML model outputs, reason about precision/recall trade\-offs, and make informed product decisions around model thresholds, confidence scoring, and human\-in\-the\-loop design patterns.
* You maintain a current and informed perspective on the AI landscape—foundation models, agentic AI, retrieval\-augmented generation, fine\-tuning—and have a point of view on how these capabilities apply to regulated industries like clinical research.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* Experience as a founder or co\-founder of a technology company, or as the first product hire at an early\-stage startup.
* Working knowledge of clinical trial data standards (CDISC SDTM/ADaM, CDASH) and regulatory submission workflows.

This is a **field\-based, remote role** that provides flexibility in work location while maintaining a strong focus on customer engagement, cross\-functional collaboration, and business impact. Regular travel is expected to support customer interactions, strategic workshops, and key customer meetings.


The annual base pay for this position ranges from $186,014\.40 \- $279,021\.60 USD Annual. Hourly and salaried non\-exempt employees will also be paid overtime pay when working qualifying overtime hours. Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition, our positions offer a short\-term incentive bonus opportunity; eligibility to participate in our equity\-based long\-term incentive program (salaried roles), to receive a retirement contribution (hourly roles), and commission payment eligibility (sales roles). Benefits offered included a qualified retirement program \[401(k) plan]; paid vacation and holidays; paid leaves; and, health benefits including medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms and conditions of the applicable plans. Additional details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. If hired, employee will be in an “at\-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base pay (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Evinova draws on AstraZeneca’s deep experience developing novel therapeutics, informed by insights from thousands of patients and clinical researchers.  **empower Chefs to nourish the world.**

**AI Integration \& Design Innovation**

* Stay ahead of the rapidly evolving AI tooling landscape and serve as an internal resource for best practices, responsible use, and practical application within a brand design context
* Foster a team culture that embraces experimentation with emerging tools while maintaining the quality standards and creative integrity the brand demands

* Build a culture of trust, openness, accountability, and a relentless pursuit of design excellence — where high standards are a shared value, not just a directive
* Lead by doing: maintain mastery of the tools the team uses daily (Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Claude Design, and relevant AI design tools) and be willing to roll up your sleeves alongside the team when needed


**Cross\-Functional Partnership**
* Partner with teammates, peers, and key stakeholders to proactively identify opportunities or challenges, and take a leadership role in bringing tangible design solutions forward
* Partner directly with brand copy team to define visual storytelling approach, ensuring consistency and deep integration between these teams to maximize efficiency and effectiveness of all creative output
* Assume a strong company presence as an internal standard\-bearer of category\-defining creativity, building trust, alignment, and influence across the organization
* Bring principles of design thinking, a solution\-oriented mindset, and an entrepreneurial spirit to achieving impactful results without depending on significant resources


**Minimum Requirements**
* 8\+ years experience in brand design; experience in top consumer brands and/or agencies is a plus
* 4\+ years managing other designers
* A respected brand design leader with a track record of shipping excellent work and a portfolio demonstrating a mastery of design craft across multiple disciplines of design
* Proficiency in video and how to leverage design in this format is a plus
* Passion for insights and performance data in shaping creative work and a commitment to building a culture that embraces these essential inputs

 Hey, hello, hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
   

  

 Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Where and how you can work**
 Our headquarters is in sunny Sydney, Australia, but our team spans the globe. Since we don’t have a physical campus in Argentina, this role is fully remote—giving you the flexibility to do your best work from wherever you thrive.
   

  

**What You’d Be Doing In This Role**
 As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.
   

  

**At The Moment, This Role Is Focused On**
* Strategy. Act as the main leadership point of contact with responsibility for overall user and revenue growth in Argentina. You'll bring together local and global teams across marketing, sales, product, content and finance to create and execute a cohesive multi\-year growth strategy, and own the KPIs including MAUs and ARR.
* Localisation. Work closely with the regional team to optimise our product, content, pricing and packaging to meet the needs of local users, informed by a deep understanding of local market dynamics and cultural nuances across a range of audiences, including knowledge workers, SMBs, students, startup ecosystems, NGOs, and other emerging sectors.
* Leadership. Hire, inspire, drive and in some cases coach the in\-market team, ensuring a high quality bar for impact and working closely with local speciality leads on performance management.
* Budget. Partner closely with the regional team and marketing lead to shape the marketing strategy and deployment of budget.
* Sponsorship. Build and support high value relationships by acting as a local sponsor for enterprise sales, education, government, partnerships, etc.
* Public face. Represent Canva as a local figurehead across press, PR, events and community.


**You're probably a match if**
* You are strongly entrepreneurial. Founder\-style appetite for growing something big from a small start and working across everything from education to press.
* You possess experience growing a market. For example, as the regional GM or brand lead for a global SaaS company, or as a proven founder or growth lead in a startup in a high growth environment.
* You are a proven leader. Ability to grow, inspire, and coach high\-performing teams. You have high emotional intelligence and empathy, and are a deeply collaborative teammate.
* You are a strong communicator. Fully proficient in spoken and written English, and with the interpersonal skills to influence global and local stakeholders.
* You are keenly analytical. Deeply focused on KPIs and obsessive about driving actionable insights from disparate datasets and able to think about a market’s performance holistically.
* you are product oriented. Passion for improving the experience of users and the ability to translate local insights into product requirements with experience localising a global product for a particular market.
* You are values aligned. Genuinely excited by Canva’s mission and deeply aligned with our values, and with exceptional references to prove it.
* You are publicity savvy. Experience doing public speaking and acting as a public face to the press and other stakeholders.
* You are well networked. Ideally with routes into some combination of government departments, corporates, influencers, journalists and local talent

 Canva’s International supergroup is a diverse, distributed team of marketers, strategists, and growth leaders focused on expanding Canva's presence in key global markets. Our team partners with functions across Marketing, Growth, Product, Sales, Partnerships, Content, Finance, and Strategy to drive sustainable user and revenue growth in international markets.
   

  

 As the Country Manager for Argentina, you will be the main point of contact and the driving force behind Canva’s success in the country. You will own and implement a multi\-year strategic roadmap, leading cross\-functional efforts to grow the user base and scale revenue.
   

  

 This role requires deep market knowledge, a growth mindset, and strong leadership capabilities to bring together local and global teams across marketing, sales, and product in a cohesive strategy.

 Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard \- and we do \- but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

* Equity packages \- we want our success to be yours too
* Inclusive parental leave policy
* An annual Vibe \& Thrive package to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup \& more
* Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally


 Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

 We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

title: Director, Product Management
description:
### **Company Background**



Censys’ mission is to be the one place to understand everything on the internet. Frustrated by the lack of trustworthy Internet intelligence, we set out to create the industry’s most comprehensive, accurate, and up\-to\-date map of the Internet. Today, Censys delivers real\-time Internet intelligence and actionable threat insights to global governments, over 50% of the Fortune 500, and leading threat intelligence providers worldwide.


**Location:** This position is remote within the United States or Canada.



As Director of Product Management, you will guide product development through all stages of the product life cycle: identifying customer needs and developing, launching, and sustaining products, shaping the next generation of our modules. You will represent Censys to customers, vendors, and partners, synthesizing information and communicating what you learn to internal stakeholders. You will build, maintain, and develop a world class team of product managers who care deeply about our mission to be THE authority for Internet Intelligence and Insights.



As Director of Product Management for Solutions, you will lead Censys’ evolution from a best\-in\-class Attack Surface Management (ASM) product to a unified exposure management solution, spanning 1st party and 3rd party risk visibility. You’ll shape the strategic direction and execution of products that define how organizations understand, monitor, and secure their presence on the Internet— working cross\-functionally to deliver value to our customers and advance Censys’ leadership in Internet Intelligence.



This is a critical leadership role for a deeply technical, business\-savvy product leader who can translate complex Internet\-scale challenges into clear, executable product strategies. You’ll lead a high\-performing team of product managers, partner with engineering, design and research, and collaborate across go\-to\-market functions to bring innovative solutions to market.


**What You’ll Do**


* Lead and develop a world\-class team of Product Managers focused on Censys’ attack surface management and supply chain intelligence
* Define and drive the unified product vision across ASM and supply chain risk management, strategy, and roadmap, connecting core capabilities like asset discovery, ownership, risks, and analytics into cohesive customer workflows.
* Partner closely with engineering leadership to prioritize and deliver features that scale, perform, and differentiate Censys’ platform in the cybersecurity market.
* Partner with Design and AI teams to make exposure management insights more intuitive, conversational, and actionable within customer workflows.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Research to ensure customer feedback, market insights, and competitive signals are continuously integrated into product planning.
* Establish and scale best\-in\-class product management processes, ensuring clarity of priorities, crisp execution, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Identify and validate new opportunities for Censys’ platform — including integration with third\-party ecosystems, developer enablement, and next\-generation intelligence capabilities.
* Represent Censys externally with customers, partners, and at industry events, evangelizing our vision and shaping market perception of Internet Intelligence.
* Measure success rigorously, using both quantitative (usage, adoption, ARR contribution) and qualitative (customer feedback, internal alignment) signals to iterate effectively.


**About You**


* 10\+ years of product management experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing other PMs.
* Proven success building and scaling enterprise SaaS or data platforms, ideally in cybersecurity or risk intelligence domains.
* Deep understanding of Attack Surface Management (ASM), Internet data, or adjacent areas such as threat intelligence, network discovery, or cloud security posture management.
* Strong technical acumen — you can comfortably discuss APIs, data pipelines, and architectural tradeoffs with engineers, and speak credibly with CISOs and technical buyers.
* Demonstrated ability to influence executive strategy through data\-driven insights and market storytelling.
* Track record of driving cross\-functional alignment and delivering measurable business outcomes in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
* Excellent communicator — able to craft compelling product narratives for both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Skilled at balancing strategy and execution — zooming out to define a market vision, and zooming in to ship value every quarter.
* Demonstrated ability to hire, mentor, and retain top product talent.
* Prior work in startups or high\-growth SaaS environments where speed and adaptability were key.
* Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work \- demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.


**Bonus Points**


* Hands\-on familiarity with Internet\-scale systems and network protocols (e.g., TLS, DNS, BGP, etc. ).
* Experience integrating AI/ML into cybersecurity or analytics workflow.
* Experience leading product\-led growth (PLG) or usage\-based monetization strategies.


*For candidates located in a high cost of living location, the base salary range is $238,000 USD and $257,000 USD.*


*This position is located remote with no expectations to come into an office regularly.*


*Censys is an equal opportunity employer.*

As part of our hiring process, all candidates who receive an offer of employment will be asked to complete an identity verification through CLEAR.

The categories of information we may collect include identifiers (such as name and contact information), professional or employment\-related information (such as work history, education, and references), and other information you provide in your application. title: Test Engineer (Prometheus)
description:
**Job Description:**  

Prometheus Energetics is an independent U.S.\-based merchant supplier of solid rocket motors and warheads. A joint venture between Kratos Defense \& Security Solutions and Rafael Advanced Defense Systems, Prometheus combines U.S. industrial speed and credibility with decades of combat\-proven designs, manufacturing know\-how, and technical training to deliver field\-ready products at scale.


Position Summary  



  

Prometheus Energetics is seeking an experienced Test Engineer / Senior Test Engineer to serve as a primary technical authority for solid rocket motor test operations, owning the design, integration, commission, and lifecycle support of propulsion and energetic test infrastructure. Reporting directly to the Director of Engineering, this role establishes an independent, high\-rigor test engineering capability as Prometheus Energetics transitions from facility startup into high\-rate production.  

The role encompasses the full spectrum of SRM test execution\-from development and R\&D static fires through formal qualification, production acceptance, and flight test support. The ideal candidate brings 4 to 10 years of hands\-on propulsion test stand operations, data acquisition architecture, hazard containment, and test\-like\-you\-fly (TLYF) execution experience, ensuring the highest standards of safety, data fidelity, and mission success.


Key Responsibilities


Test Infrastructure Design, Integration \& Controls


* Design, develop, commission, and sustain scalable propulsion test stands and ground support equipment (GSE) supporting subscale, development, qualification, and production acceptance static firings.
* Design and integrate high\-pressure pneumatic, hydraulic, and fluid delivery systems for remotely operated test stand configurations.
* Architect industrial electrical and control systems for test cell operations, including low\-voltage power distribution, grounding/bonding, safety interlocks, PLC automation (e.g., Siemens/Allen\-Bradley), and abort logic.
* Select, integrate, and maintain high\-speed data acquisition (DAQ) hardware (kHZ to MHz sampling rates) and sensor suites, including load cells, high\-frequency pressure transducers, thermocouples, accelerometers, strain gauges, and radiometers.
* Develop and maintain automated test control sequences, DAQ configurations, and data processing tools using LabVIEW, Python, MATLAB, or PLC\-based control logic.


Test Planning, Execution \& Operations


* Lead the development of comprehensive test plans, standard operating procedures (SOPs), hazard analyses, pre\-fire checklists, and countdown sequences for motor static firings and environmental screening (vibration, thermal, shock).
* Serve as Test Conductor or Lead Test Engineer during energetic operations, directing console operators, managing countdowns, and enforcing range and safety perimeters.
* Execute static fire campaigns, real\-time telemetry monitoring, and immediate post\-test safing, ensuring safe containment of toxic combustion products and high\-pressure hardware.
* Champion Test\-Like\-You\-Fly (TLYF) practices, ensuring ground test environments, line losses, and instrumentation configurations accurately reflect flight operational profiles.
* Support production acceptance testing (PAT) and scale test operations to support rapid motor production throughput.


Data Analysis, Reporting \& Anomaly Resolution


* Process, filter, and analyze raw test data to deliver rapid post\-fire summary packages, evaluating pressure\-time traces, thrust curves, total impulse, ignition delay, and thermal/vibration environments.
* Correlate measured test data against predicted ballistic, thermal, and structural analytical models in collaboration with ballisticians and structural analysts.
* Lead root\-cause investigations and failure review boards (FRACAS/MRB) for test cell anomalies, facility hardware failures, DAQ dropouts, or unpredicted motor performance behavior.
* Maintain rigorous test stand documentation, including sensor calibration logs, channel lists, facility P\&IDs, electrical schematics, and test execution history.


Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Safety Leadership


* Partner closely with Propulsion, Manufacturing, Quality, Ballistics, and EHS teams to ensure hardware test\-readiness and design\-for\-testability (DFT).
* Strictly enforce explosive safety regulations, including DoD 4145\.26\-M, range safety requirements, ordnance handling protocols, and pressure vessel safety standards.
* Participate in formal design reviews (PDR, CDR, TRR) to provide test perspective, instrumentation access plans, and verification evidence.
* Mentor junior test engineers and technicians, fostering a culture of operational discipline, safety, and technical excellence.

  

**Experience and Skills:**
Required Qualifications


* Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline from an accredited university. (Associate's degree with 5\+ years of relevant SRM experience may be considered in lieu of a bachelor's degree.)


Experience:


* Test Engineer: Minimum of 4\-6 years of hands\-on experience in propulsion testing, energetic materials handling, rocket motor static firing, or high\-hazard aerospace test operations.
* Senior Test Engineer: 7\-10\+ years of progressive experience owning test stand infrastructure, high\-speed DAQ architecture, thrust stand design, and serving as Test Conductor for energetic operations.
* Instrumentation \& DAQ: Proven expertise in selecting, installing, calibrating, and troubleshooting high\-frequency sensors (pressure transducers, load cells, TCs, accelerometers) and high\-speed DAQ architecture.
* Controls \& Automation: Proficiency with high\-speed data acquisition software and industrial control logic (e.g., LabVIEW, MATLAB, NI PXI/CompactDAQ, Dewesoft, or PLC platforms like Siemens).
* Hazardous Operations: Direct experience with explosive safety standards (DoD 4145\.26\-M or equivalent), high\-pressure pneumatic systems (ASME/DOT), and hazardous material handling.
* Regulatory: U.S. Citizenship required (position involves ITAR/EAR restricted technology).
* Clearance: Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Secret Security Clearance.

  

**Job Benefits:*** Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance Coverage
* Life/ADD \& Short/Long Term Disability Insurance

* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
* Paid Time\-Off (PTO)
* Holidays

title: Sr. Director Development
description:
**Senior Director of Development**


Job Type: Full\-time, Exempt \| Monday – Friday, 2 days in office, 3 days remote \| Raleigh, NC (40\-60% national travel during busy seasons) \| $105,000 \- $115,000 annually \+ generous time off

**About the Organizations:**  

***North Carolina Asian Americans Together (NCAAT)*** is a nonpartisan, nonprofit 501(c)(3\) organization committed to supporting equity and justice for all by fostering community among Asian American communities and allies in North Carolina through civic engagement, leadership development, grassroots mobilization, and political participation.

***NCAAT in Action (NCAATIA)***, 501(c)(4\), is committed to supporting equity and justice for all by building political power among Asian Americans and allies in North Carolina through voter education, progressive advocacy, and leadership development.

**About the Role**


We are seeking a Senior Director of Development to lead the financial engine that powers our impact across NCAAT and NCAAT in Action. We are looking for a hands\-on fundraising leader who loves the craft of development. As the Senior Director of Development, you will be the chief engine powering our state and national impact across both our 501(c)(3\) and 501(c)(4\).


This is a role built for a practitioner who understands the non\-profit ecosystem inside and out. You are someone who knows how to translate grassroots program strategy into language that resonates with institutional foundations, and you genuinely enjoy cultivating relationships with individual donors. If you want to support the design of NCAAT/IA’s 5\-10 year individual giving pipeline, serve as the chief narrative architect for major institutional grants, pitch funders, and execute our milestone 2026 Anniversary Gala, this role offers a platform to lead by doing. You will support a team of 1: Development Manager. organization.

**What You’ll Do**  

  

**Steering NCAAT/IA’s Development Program**

* In collaboration with the Executive Director, create an annual Development plan and budget that you execute and scale to drive sustainable revenue across both entities.
* Build and utilize knowledge of issues impacting Asian communities in NC and of key voting legislation by attending and/or organizing relevant coalition meetings, forums, and other gatherings to inform the fundraising approach.
* Translate NCAAT/IA’s programmatic strategy and activities into systemic impact through the intersection of charitable giving (c3\) and advocacy/political funding (c4\).
* Serve as the internal authority on state and national philanthropic trends, integrating community\-specific data and key voting legislation into highly relevant donor pitches.
* Cultivate deep partnerships across internal program teams, ensuring a constant flow of accurate information, powerful anecdotes, and milestones to elevate external fundraising communications.
* Serve as the chief narrative architect for institutional giving and the grant writing process, setting the standard for how the organization positions its impact to major foundations.
* Collaborate with program leads and development staff to gather accurate, timely information for grant proposals, financial reports, and fundraising emails, actively identifying powerful anecdotes, community highlights, and impact stories to lift up.

**Individual Giving, Pipelines \& High\-Dollar Events**

* Design and spearhead NCAAT/IA's long\-term individual giving pipeline (5\-10 year), establishing clear metric goals for multi\-year sustainer growth.
* Individual Donor Stewardship: Architect a standardized, white\-glove stewardship program, complete with targeted updates and formalized gift acknowledgments to transition high\-net\-worth prospects into recurring major donors.
* Plan and execute premier, high\-dollar individual fundraising events, treating house parties and the marquee 2026 Anniversary Gala as strategic launchpads for donor acquisition and retention.

**Institutional Giving \& End\-to\-End Grant Ownership**

* Serve as the primary author for institutional proposals, crafting compelling, sophisticated grant narratives that translate organizational strategy into high\-yield foundation investments.
* Identify, prospect, and secure new institutional funding pipelines while deepening existing multi\-year funder relationships.
* Build and deepen existing partnerships with funders and institutional partners by acting as a highly responsive principal point of contact.
* Prepare leadership for high\-stakes funder meetings and proactively triage any critical relationship developments alongside the Executive Director.
* Proactively communicate with the Executive Director if there are any issues in funder relationships.

**Visibility, Networking \& Conference Strategy**

* Executive Presence: Represent the organization on national and state stages, delivering high\-impact public speaking presentations and securing critical pitch meetings at high\-visibility conferences.
* Collaborate with the Development Manager to identify key events, manage leadership\-level communications with external funders, and oversee rigorous post\-conference follow\-ups.

**Financial Management \& System Integrity**

* Oversee the income forecast, monitor overall cash flow, and rigorously track fundraising performance to ensure both entities maintain a strong financial position.
* Deeply understand all grant agreements, establish restricted budgets, and audit program expenses alongside accountants and operations team to guarantee total alignment with funder parameters.
* System Ownership: Partner with the Development Manager to ensure data integrity within our CRM (EveryAction) are systematically tracked, including all funder deadlines, grant deliverables, communication timelines, renewal milestones, and reporting requirements.

**Board Governance \& Partnership**

* Board Sub\-Committee Leadership: Anchor the Board of Directors’ fundraising subcommittee, setting strategic agendas and delivering actionable development toolkits.
* Author the monthly board newsletter to keep members informed of key program updates and fundraising calls to action.
* Design and facilitate interactive workshops to equip board members with modern fundraising best practices, turning them into confident, aligned brand ambassadors.

**What We’re Looking For: Who You Are**


We recognize strong candidates may not meet every qualification. If you’re excited about this role and believe your experience could contribute to our mission, we encourage you to apply.

**About you:**

* Possess a profound understanding of the cultural nuances, systemic challenges, and core priorities of the Asian American communities.
* Deep, practical experience working within the non\-profit sector; you know how non\-profits operate, and how to represent grassroots work to institutional audiences.
* You have a track record of personally writing winning grants and directly cultivating individual donor relationships that resulted in six\-figure funding.
* You are comfortable working with a budget of $2M\- $5M or more and have a clear understanding of fiscal responsibility.
* You exercise creativity and think outside the box when creating fundraising strategies.
* You have supervised, empowered, and supported people. You have established trust in your staff to perform their duties, given feedback when needed, and been accountable for how a team performed.
* You are meticulously organized and detail\-oriented. You have built and maintained systems that help you succeed in keeping track of a high\-volume complex information and details.
* You are personable and possess excellent communication, collaboration, and relationship\-building skills. You have deepened existing funder relationships and can name what came from them.
* You can juggle competing demands and focus on what’s most important at any given time. You can manage your own schedule to align with your top priorities, and you can model and assist your staff in doing the same. You can proactively identify when the demands of the job outpace your capacity and come up with solutions that work for you and your colleagues.
* You are comfortable traveling for national fundraising events, especially during busy seasons.

**These experiences would add to your profile**:

* You are familiar with 501(c)(3\) and 501(c)(4\) life cycle. Not required, but helpful, and we can support your learning.
* You understand the national political landscape and how North Carolina makes an impact.

**Core NCAAT Leadership Competencies**

**Strategic and Mission\-Driven Leadership**  

Leads with a clear understanding of NCAAT’s mission, values, and long\-term goals. Translates strategic vision into actionable plans that strengthen organizational impact. Anticipates emerging trends in civic and political landscapes and adapts strategies accordingly.

**Relationship and Collaboration Skills**  

Builds and sustains strong partnerships across teams, coalitions, and political stakeholders. Navigates complex relationships with diplomacy and cultural sensitivity while fostering trust and accountability across internal and external collaborators.

**Communication and Influence**  

Articulates complex ideas with clarity and credibility across diverse audiences. Serves as a compelling spokesperson and advocate for AAPI communities. Demonstrates sound political judgment in both internal communications and external messaging.

**Personal and Professional Effectiveness**  

Demonstrates high emotional intelligence, self\-awareness, and resilience under pressure. Manages competing priorities with composure and models professional integrity, adaptability, and ethical decision\-making.

**Operational and Technical Proficiency**  

Applies strong analytical and project management skills to drive efficiency and accountability. Uses data, research, and evaluation tools to inform strategy and measure outcomes. Oversees budgets, contracts, and compliance processes responsibly.

**What We Offer:**

* **Salary:** $105,000\-$115,000 annually.
* **Hybrid Work Schedule:** 2 days in office (Monday and Wednesday)/3 days remote *plus* flex\-time Fridays. With notice, you may need to come into the office on other days depending on need (funder visits, event, etc.)
* **Health Insurance**: health, dental, and vision insurance
* **Wellness Stipend**: quarterly $100 wellness stipend ($400 yearly total per employee) to be used towards.
* **Time Off**: 4 weeks of paid time off (increases with time worked at the organization) for vacation, sick, and wellness, and 12 paid holidays (option to swap based on religious or cultural needs).
	+ Due to the nature of our work, we require “all hands on deck” during election season.
* **Optional 401k plan:** vesting start at 2 years
* **Professional Development**: $600 stipend towards Asian language courses and ongoing training opportunities.

**What to Expect – Interview Process**

* Screening interview with Dear Recruiter, the search firm partnering with us on this hire (Teams)

* Activity Exercise: 1\-hour
* Final Round: an in\-person interview in Raleigh, NC with the Executive Director, Senior HR Director, Development Manager, and Finance Director.
* Reference checks before an offer is extended

**How to Apply**


Our priority deadline for this application is September 30\. Please submit your resume by filling out the application here: https://northcarolinaasianamericanstogether.applytojob.com/apply/eQYHEG8Rnk/Sr\-Director\-Of\-Development

**Equal Opportunity**
